【訊息稱英偉達Rosa CPU採用臺積電A16工藝 搭配背面供電技術】據報道，英偉達下一代Rosa CPU有望採用臺積電A16工藝，並搭配背面供電技術。相比較N2P工藝，臺積電的A16工藝最高提升晶片密度1.1倍，核心變化是引入Super Power Rail（超級供電軌）背面供電技術，把供電網路移至晶圓背面，從而提高供電效率、降低IR drop（壓降），並釋放正面佈線空間用於訊號互連。

【NVIDIA Rosa CPU said to target TSMC A16 process with backside power delivery】A business-times blog on July 9 reported NVIDIA’s next-generation Rosa CPU is expected to use TSMC’s A16 process paired with backside power delivery (Super Power Rail). Versus N2P, A16 can raise chip density by up to 1.1x; shifting the power network to the wafer backside should improve power-delivery efficiency, reduce IR drop and free front-side routing for signal interconnects.

【Australia, India sign uranium export deal as India expands nuclear power】During Prime Minister Modi's visit to Australia, the two countries signed an agreement allowing Australia to sell uranium to India for power generation. India's foreign ministry said purchases will be used "only for peaceful purposes." The statement gave no volumes or timing. Australian Prime Minister Albanese said an administrative arrangement was signed to facilitate uranium exports to help raise the share of non-fossil fuel power and provide an additional market for Australia's resources sector. Australia holds the world's largest uranium reserves but has only three operating mines, all in South Australia.

【Tinci Materials says 'solid-state battery breakthrough' would have limited impact within five years】Tinci Materials shares plunged 23.12% from the July 6 opening price of 52.20 yuan to a midday close of 40.13 yuan today, cutting market value from over 106.4 bln yuan to 81.8 bln yuan and erasing about 24.6 bln yuan over four trading sessions. A July 8 note circulating among investors claimed next‑generation solid‑state cells could fully replace traditional lithium‑ion materials including electrolytes and separators. Tinci’s company secretary rejected that view, saying "We do not think so," and added that incremental annual demand and use cases for liquid electrolytes remain strong. The company said it does not expect solid‑state batteries to take a very large share within five years, a judgment it said is shared with CATL.

【天賜材料回應“固態電池技術突破”小作文：五年內影響有限】昨日一份關於”固態電池技術交流會紀要”在投資者圈中廣泛傳播，新一代固態電池技術有望實現電解液、隔膜等傳統鋰電材料的全面替代，甚至提出電解液行業或將被“完全淘汰”，隔膜等材料亦將被替代。”我們不認為是這樣。”天賜材料董秘在電話採訪中明確否認固態電池衝擊論調。其表示，液態電池每年的銷售增量和應用場景仍然非常好。“我們認為，固態電池在5年內不會有非常大的佔比，這一判斷是與寧德時代的共識。 (藍鯨新聞)

【China-backed potash project in Congo-Brazzaville likely to resume production in early 2027】Congo-Brazzaville officials confirmed the Bougou‑Massi potash project, developed with investment from Shenzhen Luyuan Mining, is expected to restart commercial potash production in early 2027. The minister of mines and geology said trial production is planned for end-2026 with full commercial output in Q1 2027. The Kouilou province project targets first-phase KCl output of 600,000 t/yr, expandable to 2.0 mln t/yr, and includes construction of a dedicated maritime export terminal. Officials say Bougou‑Massi is the fastest-progressing potash project among current plans in Congo-Brazzaville.

【中企投資剛果（布）鉀鹽產業有望明年初重啟生產】剛果（布）官方確認，依託中國深圳魯源礦業投資開發的布穀馬西鉀鹽專案，該國有望於2027年初重啟鉀肥商業化生產，終結數十年無規模化鉀鹽產出的局面，該專案也是當前剛果所有鉀鹽規劃中進度最快的專案。據礦業與地質部長介紹，布穀馬西專案計劃2026年底啟動試生產，2027年一季度實現全面投產。專案位於奎盧省，一期規劃年產氯化鉀60萬噸，遠期可擴容至200萬噸，且配套建設專屬海運出口碼頭。

【美伊停火狀態岌岌可危 霍爾木茲海峽交通幾近停滯】美國連續兩天襲擊伊朗，脆弱的美伊停火局面看起來愈發像要破裂了，霍爾木茲海峽交通週四幾近停滯。船舶追蹤資料顯示，這條世界上最重要的能源通道里，目前可觀測到的活動主要發生在伊朗批准的靠北航線上，而美國支援的阿曼走廊則沒什麼動靜。大型船隻中，只看到一艘受美國製裁的超級油輪從波斯灣駛出，與一艘懸掛伊朗國旗的集裝箱船一道航線。不過，也不排除有些關閉了應答器的船隻正在透過海峽。之前，伊朗襲擊船隻引發了美國的打擊，美國總統唐納德·特朗普也稱停火結束了。週三該海峽雙向共有14艘大宗商品運輸船隻透過，為6月中旬達成臨時和平協議以來最少的一天。

【South Korea's Supreme Court sentences Yoon to 7 years in obstruction-of-arrest case】On the afternoon of the 9th (local time), South Korea's Supreme Court sentenced former President Yoon Suk-yeol to 7 years for obstructing an arrest. The court found that after declaring emergency measures at the end of 2024, Yoon in early 2025 used the presidential security service to prevent the Corruption Investigation Office for High-ranking Officials (CIO) and other agencies from executing an arrest. This is the Supreme Court's first final ruling among several cases tied to the emergency-martial-law episode. Seoul Central District Court handed a 5-year sentence at first instance in January 2026; the Seoul High Court upheld a 7-year term on appeal in April 2026.
【尹錫悅涉嫌妨礙逮捕案三審被判有期徒刑7年】當地時間9日下午，韓國大法院（最高法院）就前總統尹錫悅在緊急戒嚴事件後，涉嫌動用總統警衛部門阻止韓國執法機構對其實施抓捕一案等進行宣判，尹錫悅獲刑7年。這是尹錫悅身負多項涉緊急戒嚴事件的司法案件中，韓國大法院首次作出的三審判斷。

【花唄回應“崩了”：系統升級已完成，現可以正常使用，未還款產生利息可聯絡處理】日前，有大量使用者反映支付寶花唄在進行還款時，還款頁面無法正常開啟。據使用者上傳的截圖顯示，點開花唄頁面會出現“網路繁忙”或在賬單頁面顯示“因機構維護，賬單暫時無法檢視”。對於上述情況，新浪財經問詢了螞蟻方面，截至發稿前暫無回應。花唄官方客服則表示：“目前系統升級已完成，您可以正常使用了。若賬號為寬限期最後一天沒還上貸款，產生的利息可以聯絡我們處理。”（新浪科技）

【廣東西江干流全線出現洪峰水位 】記者9日從廣東省水文局瞭解到，受上游來水、思賢滘分洪和下游潮汐共同影響，連日來，西江干流水位持續上漲。目前，廣東省西江干流已全線出現洪峰水位。從8日晚到9日凌晨，肇慶封開江口站、德慶站、高要站，雲浮都城大堤站、六都大堤站等出現洪峰水位，其中江口站、都城大堤站、德慶站分別超過警戒水位2.16米、1.37米、1.02米。當前，廣東省水文局持續關注雨水情動態發展，加強水文監測和水情會商，滾動釋出預報預警和風險提示，做好防洪各項水文測報工作。水文專家提醒，西江水位仍然較高，沿江堤圍長時間受水浸泡，退水期間易出現險情，需繼續做好防洪工作。

【Goldman Sachs: Japan corporate M&A still in early stage】Xu Mingyin, head of Goldman Sachs Asia direct investments, said on Thursday that corporate acquisitions and private equity activity in Japan remain at an early stage and that the equity market is well positioned for consolidation. She named Japan, South Korea and Australia as the most profitable Asian markets for M&A and privatizations given stable economies and large corporates. Foreign private equity activity in Japan has risen over the past three years, driven by corporate governance reforms that are increasing pressure on companies and boards to lift investor returns. Xu noted Japan has about 4,000 listed companies versus roughly 5,000 in the US, even though the US economy is about six times larger; Germany has only about 400 listed firms. She added that more than 1,000 Japanese companies report annual revenue above US$1bn, making them attractive targets, and that Japan is still at an early stage in any process of trimming excess listings.

【廣西回應六藍水庫現狀：六藍水庫水位下降，水庫缺口和流量基本穩定】今天，#廣西南寧防汛救災釋出會#通報：位於橫州市的六藍、雲表兩座水庫都建於1958年，屬於中型水庫，壩體都是均質土壩。從7月6日起，水利專家到現場開展搶險救災指導，對出現漫壩缺口的水庫進行評估，密切觀測水位變化，檢視堤壩變形情況，分析下洩流量，研究降低水位的相關措施，防止險情進一步擴大。 “目前，六藍水庫水位已降到大壩基岩以下，水庫缺口和流量已基本穩定；從8日起，當地對六藍水庫上壩道路進行了修復，到今天上午為止，已經修通到壩頂；從今天開始，還將組織開展河道疏通清淤。由於雲表水庫的水位已基本降到了死水位，如果上游不再有較大來水，水庫對下游淹沒區的影響將趨於穩定。同時，將再次組織開展全市水利工程隱患排查，重點對強降雨影響區水庫和超汛限高水位執行水庫進行檢查，發現隱患及時處置。”

Rupiah Nears 18,100 on Safe-Haven Demand, Weak Fundamentals — The Indonesian rupiah weakened toward IDR 18,100 per U.S. dollar on Thursday, extending losses as renewed Middle East conflict spurred safe-haven flows into the greenback and reinforced higher-for-longer interest rate expectations. Domestic sentiment also deteriorated, as Indonesia's retail sales recorded their steepest annual decline in three years in May, highlighting weaker consumer spending following higher non-subsidized fuel prices. Meanwhile, June consumer sentiment slipped to its lowest level since September, suggesting households are becoming more cautious about income prospects, employment conditions, and future spending. Adding to the pressure, S&P Dow Jones Indices flagged a possible downgrade of Indonesia to frontier-market status in 2027, raising concerns over potential foreign outflows. Still, the rupiah's losses were tempered by relatively easing oil prices, stronger loan growth in May, and faster government budget execution aimed at supporting economic activity.

【Super Typhoon Bavi Maintains Intensity; Enters 24‑Hour Warning Zone Tomorrow】The China Meteorological Administration at 0600 on July 9 issued a yellow typhoon warning. Wind‑circle radii: 7‑level 350–500 km, 10‑level 280–300 km, 12‑level 100–150 km. 【Goldman Sachs: Strait of Hormuz clashes could delay oil supply recovery】Goldman Sachs said in a July 8 report that renewed disruption to Strait of Hormuz shipping could impede restoration of Middle East oil supply. Goldman estimates Persian Gulf crude output in June remained about 10.5 mln bpd below pre-conflict levels. Despite producers beginning to restart shut wells last month, Goldman warned Hormuz interruptions could slow recovery: recent tanker attacks underscore elevated transit risk and, with ceasefire status unclear, shippers may hesitate to transit, weighing on flows. Goldman estimates flows have fallen to roughly 70% of normal after the recent attacks; earlier, within 10 days of the strait’s reopening, flows had climbed to over 80% of pre-conflict levels. Flows and oil prices face two-way risk: if the 60-day talks continue and shippers obtain security guarantees and Iran secures new waivers for sales, flows could recover by end-July; if talks break down and attacks escalate, flows could fall further.

Thailand Consumer Mood Rises to 3-Month High — The University of the Thai Chamber of Commerce's Consumer Confidence Index increased to 50.7 in June 2026 from 49.5 in the previous month, which was its lowest level since November 2022. It was the first increase since February and the highest reading in three months, helped by lower oil prices and new government support. Consumers' concerns over the Middle East conflict eased as the conflict moderated, leading to lower domestic and global oil prices. The government's initial economic stimulus measures also boosted consumer confidence, supporting domestic purchasing power. This contributed to the broader recovery of the Thai economy and improved the cost of living for consumers.

【北約峰會落幕 土耳其總統贈槍作別】在土耳其首都安卡拉舉行的北約峰會8日落幕。土耳其總統埃爾多安給與會領導人贈送了一份“特別”的禮物：一把刻有各自名字的左輪手槍，以及一盒彈藥。據英國《衛報》報道，英國首相斯塔默8日在返程飛機上向記者透露了這一訊息。他說，左輪手槍上刻有他的名字，還附上一封埃爾多安解除土耳其對該槍支出口管制的信函，以便與會領導人能將禮物帶回國。不過，斯塔默最終還是將手槍留在了英國駐土耳其大使館，理由是槍支即便經由政府專機被帶回英國，在英國仍屬違法行為。（新華社）

【外資Q2重回港股、加倉科技 創業板50ETF華安（159949）半日成交逾12億領跑  機構：中報季“明牌”開啟】7月9日，A股三大指數漲跌互現。滬指下跌0.46％；創業板指上漲0.13％。受此影響，創業板50ETF華安（159949）早盤上漲0.27％，報1.837元，換手率5.96％，半日成交額12.75億元，居同類標的ETF首位。國產DRAM龍頭長鑫科技公佈科創板IPO招股意向書，新股申購日期為7月16日。長鑫科技本次發行採用戰略配售、網下發行與網上發行相結合的方式進行。國信證券分析師吳信坤等指出，二季度陸股通佔A股自由流通市值比重自一季度的5.1％提升至5.5％。二季度外資流入寧德時代、中微公司、寒武紀等較多，流出三環集團、貴州茅臺、天孚通訊等較多。港股外資主要流入科技、有色板塊等，但在科技板塊定價權整體回落明顯。嘉實基金王貴重認為，當前市場正置身於一輪由AI驅動的半導體“超級上行週期”，其長度與強度將遠超歷史任何一次行情。銀河證券指出，7月A股正式邁入中報業績披露視窗，疊加7月下旬美股科技巨頭財報集中披露，市場迎來業績預期下的“明牌”時刻。配置上，聚焦“科技輪動＋防禦配置”均衡佈局策略。投資者可直接透過股票賬戶交易創業板50ETF華安（159949），也可透過聯接基金（A類：160422；C類：160424；I類：022654；Y類：022976）參與。

Sensex Opens on a Firm Note — India’s BSE Sensex gained about 0.7% to 77,051 at the open on Thursday, recovering some ground after posting its sharpest single-session decline in three months a day earlier, although gains remained tempered by renewed tensions in the Middle East that have lifted crude oil prices. Foreign portfolio investors provided some support to the market, remaining net buyers despite Wednesday's sell-off. Meanwhile, investors are awaiting results from Tata Consultancy Services, one of the first major blue-chip companies to report, for clues on the health of corporate earnings. Meanwhile, Tata Steel reported an 11% year-over-year increase in crude steel production, while Phoenix Mills posted a 32% rise in first-quarter portfolio consumption, offering some encouraging signs from the corporate sector. Notable gainers included Unichem Lab (20%), Kalyan Jewellers (10%), Jindal Drilling (8.5%), and Aequs (6.9%). On the downside, Reliance fell 2.6%, followed by Polycab (-2.1%), and Infosys (-2%).

【HSBC raises LG Electronics target 56% to KRW 280,000, keeps Buy as B2B shift accelerates】HSBC says LG Electronics’ pivot to a B2B mix—auto parts, AI data centers and robotics—appears to be accelerating and should sustain strong earnings momentum. HSBC expects Q3 operating profit of KRW 1.1 trillion, raised EPS forecasts by 6% for 2026, 9% for 2027 and 14% for 2028, and lifted its target price 56% to KRW 280,000 while maintaining a Buy rating. 【美軍空襲伊朗胡齊斯坦省已致3死多傷】據伊朗方面當地時間9日訊息，美軍當天上午針對伊朗西南部胡齊斯坦省首府阿瓦士市郊的空襲已造成3人死亡，另有多人受傷。胡齊斯坦省安全部門官員稱，伊方正在調查和評估美軍此次空襲的規模和造成的損失。

【十年創業七年0薪，長鑫上市後朱一明身家或達900億】7月9日，備受關注的長鑫科技披露科創板上市招股意向書及《發行安排及初步詢價公告》，正式啟動科創板IPO發行程式。據公告，公司新股網下申購日和網上申購日均為2026年7月16日。 多位市場分析人士預測，這家本土儲存晶片巨頭的市值有望衝刺2萬億元至3萬億元大關，甚至躋身A股市值最高公司的競爭行列。 作為長鑫科技創始人、董事長，同時也是兆易創新創始人的朱一明，其個人財富也將迎來重估。 據胡潤百富榜，截至2025年8月底，朱一明財富為120億元。記者根據長鑫科技招股書披露的持股情況，以及朱一明目前持有的兆易創新股份測算，若長鑫上市後市值達到2萬億元至3萬億元，其身家有望增至700億元以上，在未扣除擬轉讓給員工的股權激勵前，最高甚至可能超過900億元。 從2005年回國創辦兆易創新，到2016年推動國產DRAM專案落地，再到2018年把全部重心轉向長鑫科技，並承諾"專案盈利前不領薪"，朱一明用了十餘年時間完成了一場國產儲存產業的長跑。（第一財經）

【高盛：霍爾木茲海峽衝突升級或延緩原油供應復甦程序】高盛集團表示，若緊張局勢再度升溫導致霍爾木茲海峽航運受阻，中東原油供應復甦節奏或將被拖慢。高盛測算資料顯示，6月波斯灣原油日產量仍較戰前水平低約1050萬桶。包含尤利婭・熱特科娃・格里格斯比（Yulia Zhetkova Grigsby ）在內的分析師釋出研報稱：“過去一個月中東產油國雖已逐步重啟關停油井，但霍爾木茲海峽航運中斷風險可能放緩原油復產進度。”該行稱，當前波斯灣原油運輸量與油價均存在雙向風險。若雙方60天談判順利推進、航運安全保障落地且美國重新發放伊朗原油出口豁免，原油運輸有望在7月底恢復；倘若談判破裂、油輪襲擊事件進一步升級，運量或將再度下滑。上月隨著霍爾木茲海峽航運逐步回暖，高盛與多家投行同步下調油價預期，其分析師也曾預警原油市場或將再度出現供應過剩局面。

【TrendForce forecasts Q3 Server DRAM contract prices up 13–18% QoQ】TrendForce’s latest memory-price survey says some chipmakers had already reflected increases in their 2Q26 quotes, while several US cloud service providers have signed multi-year LTAs that limit vendors’ ability to raise prices for those accounts. TrendForce estimates Server DRAM contract prices will rise 13–18% QoQ in Q3. Persistent supply tightness, however, could still prompt suppliers to compete by lifting quotes further.

【集邦諮詢：預估第三季Server DRAM合約價將季增13%—18%】根據TrendForce集邦諮詢最新儲存器價格調查，由於部分原廠提早於2026年第二季的報價反映漲幅，加上數家美系雲端服務供應商（CSP）已簽署多年期長約（LTA），限制原廠對該類客戶的漲價空間，TrendForce集邦諮詢預估第三季Server DRAM合約價將季增13%—18%。然而，隨著供不應求格局延續，後續仍可能出現各家原廠競相上修報價的情況。
【奧拓電子連續落地歐洲多個虛擬影棚專案】近期，奧拓電子加速佈局歐洲虛擬製作市場，接連落地多個標杆級虛擬製作專案，業務覆蓋商業影視創作、高校實訓教學兩大核心場景。

【Shandong holds robot and intelligent equipment industry matchmaking event in Jinan】July 9 — Shandong held a robot and intelligent equipment industry matchmaking event in Jinan. The China Electronic Information Industry Development Research Institute and the Shandong Provincial Department of Industry and Information Technology released a Shandong robot and intelligent equipment industry brand matrix and announced the province's first batch of 26 key embodied-intelligence robot training sites. The event inaugurated the Shandong Robot and Intelligent Equipment Industry Alliance and the Shandong Robot Standardization Committee, and included signing of public-service projects such as an intelligent robot transmission-system testing center. Leading firms Youbote, Guanglun Intelligent and Zhiyuan Robotics signed strategic regional cooperation agreements. Jinan also set up two provincial-level robot industry funds for its central district and start-up zone.
【花唄致歉】7月8日晚間，有大量使用者反映支付寶花唄在進行還款時，還款頁面無法正常開啟。根據使用者上傳的截圖顯示，點開花唄頁面會出現“網路繁忙”或在賬單頁面顯示“因機構維護，賬單暫時無法檢視”。針對該問題，記者諮詢支付寶客服，客服表示，目前系統升級已完成，可以正常使用了。由此帶來的不便深表歉意。客服還稱，“花唄有三天寬限期，在寬限期內完成還款，不會影響徵信。”（中新經緯）

【山東省機器人和智慧裝備產業對接活動在濟南舉辦】7月9日，山東省機器人和智慧裝備產業對接活動在濟南舉辦。活動中，中國電子資訊產業發展研究院和山東省工業和資訊化廳共同釋出了山東省機器人和智慧裝備產業品牌矩陣圖。同時釋出山東省首批26家重點建設的具身智慧機器人訓練場名單，並進行了山東省機器人和智慧裝備產業聯盟及山東省機器人標準化委員會的揭牌儀式。此外，還組織了智慧機器人傳動系統檢測中心等公共服務類專案簽約，優寶特、光輪智慧、智元機器人等一批頭部企業區域落地專案進行戰略合作簽約。同時成立濟南市中區、起步區兩大省級機器人專項產業基金。
【TPG、黑石擬出售豪洛捷醫療外科業務，目標估值超40億美元】英國《金融時報》援引不願具名知情人士訊息稱，TPG與黑石計劃出售豪洛捷旗下外科業務板塊，尋求超40億美元交易對價，以此償還債務，並回籠去年收購這家醫療科技企業的資金。本次資產出售流程尚處於初期階段，最終未必能達成交易。今年4月，TPG、黑石聯合穆巴達拉投資公司與新加坡政府投資公司，以183億美元完成豪洛捷私有化收購。

Malaysia Industrial Output Growth Strongest Since 2022 — Malaysia’s industrial production grew by 8.4% year-on-year in May 2026, falling short of market expectations for a 9.5% increase but up from an 8.2% rise in the previous month. The latest reading also marked the strongest growth since September 2022, driven largely by higher output in the mining sector, which jumped by 19.8% from 6.8% in April, as crude petroleum (-0.7% vs -6.4%) declined less, while natural gas accelerated (37.4% vs 16.6%). In contrast, production growth slightly eased for manufacturing (6.6% vs 8.3%), primarily due to declines in textiles, wearing apparel, leather products and footwear (-0.4% vs 3.4%) and transport equipment and other manufacturers (-4.8% vs 10.7%). Moreover, electricity generation increased at a softer pace (4.2% vs 10.5%). On a seasonally adjusted monthly basis, industrial output fell by 0.4% in May, reversing an upwardly revised 5.5% gain in the preceding period.

Rupee Pauses Decline After RBI FX Intervention — The Indian rupee hovered around 95.5 per dollar, pausing losses as traders pointed to likely intervention by the Reserve Bank of India through dollar sales to temper volatility. The currency remained under pressure, however, amid renewed geopolitical tensions after fresh US military strikes on Iran and retaliatory attacks on Kuwait and Bahrain fueled concerns over oil supplies. Brent crude remained on the rise, gaining more than 8% over the previous two sessions. Broader market caution also weighed on domestic assets, sending the benchmark 10-year government bond yield up 7 basis points on Wednesday, its biggest one-day rise in over three months, while Indian equities fell 2%, their steepest drop over the same period. Meanwhile, Fed meeting minutes reinforced expectations of tighter US monetary policy, with futures implying a one-in-three chance of a rate hike this month and a two-in-three probability by September.

【雀巢將斥資6.88億美元建設泰國中心，新增520個就業崗位】泰國已批准雀巢泰國有限公司一筆規模達230億泰銖（摺合6.88億美元）的投資專案，用於建設智慧工廠與配送中心，助力泰國打造區域食品飲料製造中心。泰國投資委員會於週三批覆該全新建廠專案，廠址選定在中部的沙沒巴幹府。投資委員會週四釋出公告稱，該基地計劃2028年第四季度投產，年產速溶雀巢咖啡、複合咖啡飲品及即飲飲料17萬噸。隨著跨國企業佈局東南亞多元化供應鏈，泰國正大力引進科技型製造與高附加值食品產業，本次投資正是這一趨勢的印證。雀巢方面表示，其在泰國的經營歷史已超130年。雀巢介紹，這座新工廠將運用人工智慧、機器人自動化裝置與先進生產系統，提升生產效率並降低環境碳排放，預計為泰國當地工程師及技術專業人才提供520餘個工作崗位。

【Tokyo Electron aims to halve equipment startup time】Nikkei reports Tokyo Electron aims to halve equipment startup time after delivery, starting with new models; CEO Kawai said the company will deploy robotics in production to shorten lead times. He said monthly order volumes are rising and that almost all major customers plan new fabs within the next two years. Tokyo Electron's Tokyo-listed shares showed buying interest today.

Palm Oil Dips Ahead of Key Monthly Data — Malaysian palm oil futures traded lower, hovering below MYR 4,600 per tonne and retreating after recent gains as softer Chicago soyoil prices weighed on sentiment. Also, market participants remained cautious ahead of the Malaysian Palm Oil Board’s monthly report, with Reuters projecting stocks likely hit a record June high as output outpaced demand. In India, the world’s top buyer, June imports fell to a 14-month low on sluggish consumption and a narrowing discount versus rival oils. Still, losses were cushioned by a weaker ringgit, firmer edible oil prices on China’s Dalian exchange, and stronger crude oil, which boosts palm’s appeal as biodiesel feedstock. Demand prospects brightened after cargo surveyors estimated July 1–5 exports rose between 10.6% and 11.1% from the same period in June. Meanwhile, in China, another major importer, consumer prices rose less than expected while factory-gate inflation showed signs of peaking, underscoring a mixed backdrop for edible oil demand.

【道明證券：SK海力士ADR上市相關資金流帶來提振 但韓元料難改疲軟趨勢】道明證券表示，儘管本週SK海力士創紀錄的ADR上市提振了韓元，但鑑於美元整體走強，韓元可能仍將保持疲軟。道明證券策略師Howard Du等人在報告中寫道，預計美元將保持堅挺，直到美國經濟資料出現疲軟並導致市場淡化美聯儲加息預期；近期走勢表明，韓元任何實質性反彈都只發生在美元整體疲軟的情況下。報告寫道，淨股票投資組合從韓國流出至美國，這是今年以來令韓元承壓的一個因素，但近幾周來這個趨勢似乎已趨於平穩；這使得韓元在7月得以反彈。美元/韓元的1493-1494一線是需要關注的關鍵價位；如果現匯在未來一週繼續維持在該價位上方，預期美元上漲趨勢將持續的投資者應在該價位附近再次買入美元。

【Ant Group open-sources LingBot-Video, MoE-based video foundation model for embodied intelligence】Ant Group has open-sourced LingBot-Video, described as the world’s first open-source video foundation model for embodied intelligence built on a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture. By replacing traditional dense architectures with MoE to expand capacity while controlling per-inference cost, the 30B-parameter model activates roughly 3B parameters during generation—about three times the inference efficiency of a comparable dense model—aiming to combine large-scale visual expressiveness with the efficient inference required for embodied intelligence.

【螞蟻靈波開源全球首個具身影片基模】螞蟻靈波開源LingBot-Video，這是全球首個基於Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）架構、面向具身智慧的開源影片生成基礎模型。據悉，LingBot-Video構建了資料畫像引擎，在海量網際網路影片的基礎上進一步引入VLA、VLN、Ego等機器人相關資料，覆蓋靈巧操作、機器人移動和第一視角互動等場景，總規模達7萬小時的具身資料。

【我國科考團隊利用無人機成功觀測珠峰高空臭氧垂直分佈狀況】近期，由北京大學、中國科學院等機構的科研人員組成的聯合科考團隊與大疆創新科技有限公司共同攻關，利用大疆創新最新的垂直起降複合翼無人機，從5200米海拔的珠峰大本營起飛，進行無人機搭載科考儀器的資料採集任務，成功測量了大本營地面至海拔8861米高空的臭氧垂直分佈資料。 針對珠峰地區空氣稀薄、溫差大、風場紊流強等極端環境，工程師還在無人機電池恆溫加熱、空速管防結冰、動力與飛控冗餘系統等方面進行了改進。

【德勤：受經濟擔憂影響，美國開學季消費將下降6%】根據德勤週四釋出的一項調查，隨著 經濟不確定性加劇導致消費者信心減弱，今年 美國有學齡兒童的家庭在“開學季”的消費支出（經通脹調整後）預計將下降約6%。這家諮詢公司表示，預計總支出為304億美元，平均每位K-12學生557美元，低於去年的每人570美元。調查發現，57%的消費者預計未來六個月經濟將惡化，這一比例是2020年以來的最高水平。德勤表示，預計家庭將優先購買服裝等必需品，同時削減科技產品的購買。約一半的受訪家庭計劃減少在外就餐和娛樂方面的開支，以便在預算中騰出空間用於與學校相關的採購。

【國家基本藥物目錄更新調整，新增化學藥品和生物製品68種 】專家介紹，此次國家基本藥物目錄更新調整，新增化學藥品和生物製品68種，聚焦發病率較高的慢性病和常見病，例如新增糖尿病用藥5種，高血壓用藥4種，慢性阻塞性肺疾病用藥7種，常見消化道疾病用藥8種等等，這有利於醫生對患者治療時有更多的用藥選擇，也有利於擴大基層藥品種類，加強基層用藥的銜接，滿足患者在不同情況下的用藥需求，擴大覆蓋病種範圍，新增化學藥品和生物製品覆蓋了更多病種，提高了群眾用藥的可及性。結合醫藥產業創新發展，包括4種國產Ⅰ類新藥的16種創新藥也納入了新版目錄。這些藥臨床價值高，受眾人群較多，適宜各級醫療衛生機構配備使用和推動醫藥創新研發成果更多地惠及群眾。

【新版國家基本藥物目錄釋出 更多好藥惠及基層】為更好滿足群眾疾病防治基本用藥需求，國家衛生健康委、國家中醫藥局、國家疾控局今天釋出《國家基本藥物目錄（2026版）》，將從9月1日起正式實施。新版目錄共收錄藥品794種，其中化學藥品和生物製品476種，中成藥318種。經初步測算，新版目錄藥品使用量佔全國公立醫療衛生機構配備藥品使用量的71%，體現了基本藥物作為臨床關鍵用藥的重要地位和使用的普遍性。國家衛生健康委等部門將進一步推動基本藥物優先配備使用，提升基本藥物規範使用能力，讓各級醫療衛生機構配得上、用得好，促進上下用藥銜接，讓人民群眾在家門口附近的基層醫療衛生機構也能用上和大醫院相同的藥物。

【機構：比特幣下跌，因最大企業買家Strategy轉為淨賣家】亞洲早盤交易中，比特幣下跌0.2%，至61,966.47美元。Crypto Finance的Matteo Bottacini表示，全球最大的比特幣企業持有者Strategy已成為該加密貨幣的淨賣家，因為該公司越來越需要產生現金來支付股息和其他債務。從技術角度來看，比特幣仍處於區間震盪，支撐位在58,000美元左右，阻力位在62,000-64,000美元之間。Crypto Finance表示，高點下移和低點下移的更廣泛價格結構表明，即將迎來一段盤整期。

【小鵬Robotaxi開啟內測，何小鵬稱Robotaxi是小鵬邁向“機器人汽車”的重要一步】記者9日獲悉，小鵬集團召開Robotaxi業務首次全員會，並宣佈正式啟動員工內測。何小鵬表示，未來十年，所有具身智慧載體本質都會成為機器人，Robotaxi是小鵬從新能源汽車邁向“機器人汽車”的重要一步，是成為小鵬物理AI版圖的關鍵一子。基於AI時代軟硬體融合的發展趨勢，小鵬未來將聚焦整車平臺、自動駕駛軟體及AI能力，打造服務全球合作伙伴的Robotaxi軟硬體服務商，透過輸出整套解決方案，推動Robotaxi全球化落地。

【美軍稱打擊約90個伊朗軍事目標】美軍中央司令部今天（7月9日）最新發宣告稱，完成了對伊朗新一輪打擊，旨在進一步削弱伊朗在霍爾木茲海峽“襲擊商船及無辜平民船員”的能力。宣告稱，本輪行動緊接前一晚在伊朗境內“成功實施的進攻性打擊”。美軍此次打擊了約90個伊朗軍事目標，包括防空系統、海岸監視設施、導彈與無人機儲存點、海軍作戰裝備以及沿海軍事後勤基礎設施。 宣告強調，美軍部隊繼續保持高度戒備，具備致命打擊能力，隨時準備執行由總統下達的作戰指令。（CCTV國際時訊）

【IDC：第二季度全球PC出貨量同比下降4.9%】根據IDC資料，2026年第二季度全球PC出貨量同比下降4.9%，至6820萬臺，這是連續九個季度增長後的首次下滑。持續的記憶體晶片短缺是此次反轉的主因，促使廠商儘可能提前壓貨。中國市場，2026年第二季度PC出貨量992萬臺，同比下降1.6%，同比下滑但表現好於全球，儘管記憶體價格上漲，但商用政府大型企業需求強勁。

US Natgas Prices Hold Decline — US natural gas futures held recent decline, hovering around $3.21 per MMBtu amid forecasts for a larger-than-usual weekly build in inventories. Gas stockpiles were estimated to rise by 61 bcf for the week ended July 3, exceeding the five-year average increase of 51 bcf for the same period, pointing to comfortable supply conditions. Meanwhile, weather forecasts indicate that temperatures will remain mostly above normal through July 23, likely keeping gas demand from power generators elevated. LNG export demand also remained firm, with average gas flows to major LNG export facilities rising to 17.8 bcfd so far in July, up from 17.4 bcfd in June. On the supply side, gas output in the Lower 48 states fell to 109.4 bcfd so far in July from 110.0 bcfd in June and was below the record monthly high of 110.6 bcfd reached in December 2025.

Japan 10-Year Yield Hovers at 29-Year High — Japan's 10-year government bond yield held around 2.88% on Thursday, remaining near its highest level in almost three decades as renewed conflict between the US and Iran drove oil prices higher, fueling inflation concerns and reinforcing expectations for further interest rate hikes. Disruptions to global energy supplies also weighed on Japan’s economy and, in turn, its currency and bond market, given the country’s heavy reliance on oil imports from the Middle East. Meanwhile, investors remained concerned about rising fiscal spending and increased government borrowing after Japan unveiled a broad long-term economic strategy with substantial spending commitments that could require additional debt issuance. Separately, the government revised its latest draft of the annual policy agenda, calling for appropriate monetary policy that supports stable price growth.

Indonesia Retail Sales Fall Most in 3 Years — Indonesia's retail sales dropped 3.9% yoy in May 2026, following a 3.7% decline in the prior month and marking the second straight month of contraction. It was also the steepest annual fall since May 2023, highlighting persistent weakness in household spending amid elevated inflation, driven in part by higher non-subsidized fuel prices. Sales fell further for food, beverages, and tobacco (-4.1% vs -3.8% in April), clothing (-12.0% vs -7.0%), and other household equipment (-0.9% vs 0.6%). Sales of information and communication equipment remained deeply negative, albeit slightly improving (-18.4% vs -26.4%). Meanwhile, growth eased for automotive parts and accessories (11.2% vs 14.7%) and recreational goods (0.2% vs 0.7%). Fuel sales rose 0.3%, reversing a 0.9% drop in April. Monthly, retail sales fell 1.5%, moderating from April's 11.6% plunge, the sharpest since June 2022. Retail activity is expected to remain subdued as higher living costs continue to restrain consumer spending.

【2026年APEC林業部長級會議將於7月27日到28日召開】記者從今天的國家林業和草原局新聞釋出會上瞭解到，作為APEC中國年系列活動之一，在自然資源部指導下，國家林草局、廣東省人民政府、深圳市人民政府將於7月27日—28日在深圳召開APEC林業部長級會議，會議主題為“共建綠色亞太，共享生態福祉”。亞太地區森林面積佔全球一半以上，貢獻了約全球60%的林產品生產和40%的林產品貿易，是全球陸地、海岸生態系統最富集的區域，並擁有全球近半的紅樹林資源。森林是亞太地區生態安全的堅實屏障和民生福祉的深厚支撐，在應對氣候變化、保護生物多樣性及改善居民生計中發揮著不可替代的作用。區域內各經濟體資源稟賦、發展階段差異明顯，尤其是隨著城市化的不斷加速，各經濟體面臨著全球氣候變化、森林退化、生物多樣性喪失的共同挑戰，亟須透過技術創新、森林管理和區域合作來推進發展建設。在此背景下，本屆林業部長級會議搭建高層對話平臺將凝聚共識、攜手行動，具有三重積極意義：第一、立足全球生態治理大局，貢獻亞太智慧與方案；第二、立足區域可持續發展全域性，凝聚共建清潔美麗亞太的統一行動；第三、打造長效多邊合作實體平臺，推動務實行動落地見效。（央視新聞）

【伊朗代表致函聯合國，強烈譴責美國侵略行徑】伊朗常駐聯合國代表伊拉瓦尼8日致函聯合國秘書長古特雷斯和安理會本月輪值主席、剛果（金）常駐聯合國代表澤農·恩蓋·穆孔戈，以“最強烈措辭”譴責美國一再的侵略行徑，及其持續違反《聯合國憲章》和其他國際法準則的行為。信函說，美國新一輪侵略行徑公然違反《聯合國憲章》有關條款，是對伊斯蘭堡諒解備忘錄有關條款的違背。美國反覆且蓄意違反其承諾，意味著從根本上背棄了該諒解備忘錄，須對其非法行徑及局勢危險升級所引發的一切法律和政治後果承擔全部國際責任。信函說，蓄意針對民用設施、持續針對伊朗主權和領土完整非法使用武力，構成對國際和平與安全的嚴重威脅，進一步表明美國完全無視其國際法義務。鑑於局勢的嚴重性，伊朗重申《聯合國憲章》賦予聯合國秘書長和安理會的責任，特別是在涉及侵略行為及威脅國際和平與安全等情況時應承擔的責任。伊朗緊急呼籲秘書長和安理會採取立即、有效、果斷措施，迫使美國停止其持續的非法侵略行徑，防止事態進一步升級。（新華社）

【首鋼股份：取向矽鋼的市場需求在相當一段時間內仍將保持較高增長】首鋼股份(000959)7月8日在電話會議中就矽鋼行業的供需態勢表示，作為電力系統重要的軟磁基礎材料，取向矽鋼的市場需求在相當一段時間內仍將保持較高增長。基於需求的確定增長，近年國內取向矽鋼產能也快速提升，預計2026年整體產能仍保持增長。總體看，取向矽鋼供需兩端整體雙增，電力行業的發展變化將推動取向矽鋼向“高效化、高階化、綠色化”升級。無取向矽鋼方面，預計2026年國內總需求1500萬噸左右，在新能源汽車以及以人形機器人、低空經濟、高階智慧裝備為代表的新質生產力領域將有較大幅度增長。供給端，無取向矽鋼產能保持增長趨勢。總體看，無取向矽鋼供大於求局面沒有改變，且供需結構存在錯配，或將加速落後產能出清。

New Zealand Dollar Rises Further — The New Zealand dollar climbed to around $0.572, the highest level in nearly three weeks, following the central bank’s hawkish stance, while data showed strong manufacturing growth. New Zealand’s manufacturing activity expanded at the fastest pace in almost five years in June, adding to signs of a pickup in economic growth as RBNZ Governor Anna Breman highlighted improving momentum in the second half of the year. The central bank raised its official cash rate by 25 bps on Wednesday for the first time in three years, saying that an increase in demand could add to medium-term inflation pressures. The decision came as oil prices began rising again following renewed hostilities between the US and Iran, reinforcing the central bank’s concerns over inflation. Breman said higher fuel prices remained the key upside risk to inflation, warning that if the conflict persists, there is a risk that inflation could become embedded.

【美媒：美伊在霍爾木茲海峽的衝突或持續一週乃至一個月】據Axios網站，美國白宮正為可能與伊朗在霍爾木茲海峽展開持續數日甚至數週的交火做準備。一位美國官員透露，目前的局勢升級可能會持續一兩天、一週或一個月，這取決於伊朗是否繼續襲擊霍爾木茲海峽的商船。“我們要給他們一點教訓，讓他們知道我們不是好惹的，”這位美國官員稱。目前外交陷入停滯，軍事壓力重新成為特朗普戰略的核心。美國官員表示，白宮認為有更大的升級空間，因近幾周已有數百艘油輪透過海峽駛離海灣，這緩解了政府內部對再次衝突將立即引發油價大幅飆升的擔憂。

US 10-Year Yield Holds at 7-Week High — The yield on the 10-year US Treasury note hovered around 4.58% on Thursday, remaining near a seven-week high as renewed conflict in the Middle East pushed oil prices higher, fueling inflation concerns and strengthening expectations for further interest rate hikes. The US military confirmed it had carried out strikes on Iran for a second straight day in an effort to curb Tehran’s ability to threaten navigation through the Strait of Hormuz, while Iran threatened a large-scale retaliatory operation against US military bases across the region. Meanwhile, minutes from the Federal Reserve’s June meeting showed that only a few policymakers favored a rate increase, though officials expressed growing concern over inflation. Markets continue to price in at least one Fed rate hike by the end of 2026. Investors are now awaiting the latest weekly jobless claims and existing home sales data for fresh guidance on the interest rate outlook.

Indonesia Shares Edge Higher — Indonesian equities firmed modestly on Thursday morning, with the IDX Composite Index adding 14 points or 0.2% to 5,883, clawing back steep losses from the prior session. The rebound tracked stronger U.S. futures after Wall Street closed mostly lower overnight, weighed by renewed U.S.–Iran tensions and higher oil prices. Locally, sentiment was lifted by an uptick in June forex reserves and quicker state budget execution in H1 2026. In top trading partner China, headline inflation eased to 1.1% in June, undershooting forecasts as food costs fell further. However, gains in Jakarta were capped by concerns over a possible downgrade to frontier-market status in 2027, flagged by S&P Dow Jones Indices. Meanwhile, consumer sentiment slipped for a second month in June, hitting its weakest since last September. 【AI-augmented rare-event sampling cuts extreme-weather simulation compute by 1,000x】A US-France research team published in Physics World an AI-augmented rare-event sampling (RES) climate simulation framework that uses AI to pre-screen meteorological fields likely to spawn heatwaves or extreme cyclones and runs full physical simulations only for those high-risk windows, cutting compute to about 1/1,000 of full-domain simulation. Benchmarked on the PlaSim simplified climate model, the method produced mid-latitude heatwave frequency estimates closely matching full simulations and is applicable to analysis of current European heatwaves. ETH Zurich researchers say the approach remedies narrow screening in traditional RES, can be expanded to heavy rainfall and typhoon prediction, and is adaptable to higher-resolution climate models.

China 10Y Yield Extends Decline — China's 10-year government bond yield fell to 1.73% on Thursday, extending the previous session's decline and touching its lowest level in a week as investors responded to the People's Bank of China's reaffirmation of an accommodative monetary policy stance. The central bank pledged to maintain appropriately supportive policy settings and strengthen financial backing for domestic consumption, while acknowledging persistent imbalances between robust supply and relatively weak demand. Recent data showed that annual consumer inflation eased to a three-month low of 1.0% in June from 1.2% in May, while producer-price inflation increased to 4.1% from 3.9%, marking its fastest pace since July 2022. The latest figures highlighted the continued divergence between consumer and factory-gate price trends. Nevertheless, the PBOC has kept key interest rates and reserve requirement ratios unchanged, focusing instead on refining its policy framework and improving monetary policy transmission.

Offshore Yuan Snaps 3-Day Losing Streak — The offshore yuan rose to around 6.79 per dollar on Thursday, snapping a three-session losing streak, as stronger producer-price growth reinforced expectations that deflationary pressures are easing despite still-muted consumer demand. Meanwhile, annual consumer inflation eased to a three-month low of 1% from 1.2% in May. While rising global prices for oil, semiconductors, and industrial metals have lifted factory-gate prices, weak domestic demand has limited cost pass-through to consumers, keeping pressure on profit margins. On the monetary policy front, the central bank reiterated its commitment to maintaining an appropriately accommodative stance and strengthening financial support for domestic consumption, while acknowledging the persistent imbalance between robust supply and relatively weak demand.

【截至5月底 全國基本醫保參保較去年同期增長超400萬人】國家醫保局召開例行新聞釋出會，介紹2026年上半年全國醫療保障工作情況。2026年基本醫保參保人數穩中有升，截至5月底，基本醫保參保人數較去年同期增長超過400萬人，參保率穩定在95%。國家醫保局相關負責人介紹，我國基本醫保參保結構不斷最佳化。截至2025年底，全國基本醫保參保13.31億人，同比增加407萬人，參保率鞏固在95%。其中，職工醫保參保3.89億人，比上年增加907.78萬人，增長2.4%。“十四五”期間職工醫保參保人數年均增加880萬人，年均增長2.4%。基金執行總體保持平穩。2025年全國基本醫保（含生育保險）基金總收入3.59萬億元，基金總支出3.01萬億元。其中，職工醫保統籌基金（含生育保險）收入1.83萬億元，支出1.36萬億元。居民醫保基金收入1.12萬億元，支出1.07萬億元。享受待遇人次持續增加。2025年，基本醫保參保人待遇享受人次為87.53億人次，同比增長4.9%。

The central bank signaled that it would keep monetary policy appropriately loose and step up financial support to boost domestic consumption, while acknowledging an imbalance between strong supply and weak demand. The PBOC has kept rates and reserve requirement ratios unchanged, focusing instead on refining its policy framework and transmission mechanisms. On the economic front, annual consumer inflation eased to a three-month low of 1% in June from 1.2% in May, while producer inflation rose to 4.1% from 3.9%, the fastest pace since July 2022. The latest hostilities pushed oil prices higher, fueling inflation concerns and reinforcing expectations that interest rates could remain higher for longer. Meanwhile, minutes from the Federal Reserve’s June meeting showed that only a few policymakers favored a rate increase, though officials expressed growing concern over inflation. Markets continue to price in at least one Fed rate hike by the end of 2026. Investors are now awaiting the latest weekly jobless claims and existing home sales data for fresh clues on the interest rate outlook.

European Gas Extends Gain — European natural gas prices extended their rally, rising to €49.4 per MWh on Thursday to hover near a one-month high as the latest escalation in US-Iran tensions heightened concerns over fresh disruptions to LNG supplies from the Persian Gulf. US forces carried out additional strikes on Iran on Wednesday night, shortly after President Trump declared the end of the eight-week ceasefire. In response, Iran vowed a major retaliatory operation targeting US military bases across the region. The flare-up in tensions followed Iranian attacks on vessels in the Strait of Hormuz, which prompted the US to reimpose sanctions on Iranian oil sales. Any renewed disruption to energy flows through the strait, a key transit route for roughly one-fifth of global oil and LNG trade, could make it more difficult for Europe to replenish gas storage facilities to adequate levels ahead of the heating season.

Corn Retreats from 1-Month Peak — Corn futures fell to around $4.3 per bushel, pulling back from a one-month high reached on July 7 as traders took profits ahead of USDA's WASDE monthly report, despite surging crude oil prices. The retreat came despite increasingly bullish weather forecasts, with hotter and drier conditions expected to persist across parts of the US Midwest through late July, raising concerns over pollination during the crop's critical July 10–31 window. Weather concerns also intensified in Europe, where France's corn crop rating plunged to a 13-year low of 58% good-to-excellent following a record heatwave. Meanwhile, crude oil prices jumped after the US renewed strikes on Iran in retaliation for recent tanker attacks, limiting corn's downside as higher energy prices tend to support corn-based ethanol demand. Markets now await Friday's USDA WASDE report, which is expected to leave US corn production and yield forecasts largely unchanged, with 2026/27 ending stocks seen at around 1.96 billion bushels.

【瀚藍持股泰國曼谷垃圾焚燒發電專案即將投產】據瀚藍環境，2023年，瀚藍透過收購新源能源40%股權（國投電力持有60%），新增泰國曼谷垃圾焚燒發電專案，總處理規模達3300噸/日。2025年，公司確認該專案投資收益約1800萬元。目前，農墾一期專案（500噸/日）持續穩定運營，效益良好。在建的農墾二期與安努專案（各1400噸/日）預計將在近期投產。
【國家統計局：國際輸入性因素等帶動國內工業消費品價格漲幅回落】國家統計局城市司首席統計師董莉娟表示，從同比看，全國CPI上漲1.0%，漲幅比上月回落0.2個百分點。國際輸入性因素等帶動國內工業消費品價格漲幅回落。工業消費品價格上漲2.9%，漲幅比上月回落1.0個百分點，影響CPI同比上漲約0.90個百分點，對CPI的上拉影響比上月減少約0.28個百分點。

【NBS: June PPI -0.3% MoM; coal-mining prices +5.6% on peak-summer stocking, cooling demand】China PPI fell 0.3% MoM in June, the National Bureau of Statistics said. International crude weakness drove sharp oil-sector declines: oil extraction prices -16.0% MoM and refined petroleum products manufacturing -3.1% (widening by 14.2 and 2.8 percentage points vs May). Chemical raw-materials and chemical-fiber manufacturing shifted from MoM gains to declines of 2.0% and 0.8% respectively. Seasonal peak-summer demand lifted coal mining and washing prices 5.6% MoM; household cooling appliance manufacturing +0.6%; refrigeration and air-conditioning equipment +0.4%. Ample summer precipitation, sunlight and wind cut power prices: hydro -9.1%, solar -2.5% and wind -2.2% MoM.

【國家統計局：6月“迎峰度夏”備煤及製冷產品需求增加，煤炭開採和洗選業價格環比上漲5.6%】國家統計局城市司首席統計師董莉娟解讀2026年6月份CPI和PPI資料。從環比看，全國PPI下降0.3%。本月PPI環比執行的主要特點：國際原油價格下行，影響國內相關行業價格下降。石油開採價格環比下降16.0%，精煉石油產品製造價格下降3.1%，降幅比上月分別擴大14.2個和2.8個百分點，化學原料和化學制品製造業、化學纖維製造業價格由上月上漲分別轉為下降2.0%和0.8%。受季節性因素影響，部分行業價格走勢分化。6月份氣溫升高，“迎峰度夏”備煤及製冷產品需求增加，煤炭開採和洗選業價格環比上漲5.6%，家用製冷電器具製造價格上漲0.6%，製冷空調裝置製造價格上漲0.4%；夏季降水、光照及風力充足，水力發電、太陽能發電、風力發電價格分別下降9.1%、2.5%和2.2%。
【油氣概念延續強勢 通源石油漲超10%】油氣概念延續強勢，通源石油漲超10%，山東墨龍、潛能恆信、科力股份、泰山石油、中曼石油、凱添燃氣跟漲。

【剛果（金）埃博拉死亡病例達600例】剛果（金）衛生部8日釋出的最新疫情報告顯示，該國本輪埃博拉疫情累計報告確診病例1759例，其中死亡600例。 報告說，截至目前，疫情主要波及伊圖裡省、北基伍省和南基伍省三個省份。累計治癒病例285例，目前有750名患者處於隔離或住院治療狀態。 報告稱，三省相關醫療機構收治床位已接近飽和。其中，北基伍省收治機構承壓明顯，床位佔用率已超100%。 報告還說，喬波省首府基桑加尼報告兩例埃博拉病毒聚合酶鏈式反應(PCR)檢測呈陽性病例。其中一例與伊圖裡省有關，另一例目前尚未發現與基桑加尼以外地區存在流行病學關聯。報告稱，相關複核檢測和進一步流行病學調查正在進行。這兩例病例尚未計入全國累計病例數。 喬波省與伊圖裡省、北基伍省相鄰，基桑加尼是剛果（金）東北部重要商貿城市和交通樞紐。(新華社)

【森木磊石完成B+輪融資】近日，森木磊石宣佈完成B+輪融資。本次融資由申能誠毅領投，老股東原始碼資本、英諾基金持續追投。本輪融資將用於進一步加大技術研發投入，加速PPEC Workbench跨架構嵌入式開發平臺（IDE）的迭代升級，深化在可控核聚變、核醫療、人造金剛石等前沿領域的應用佈局，同時加強團隊人才梯隊建設與市場渠道拓展。

【National Bureau of Statistics: June domestic gold jewelry and gasoline prices fell 8.7% and 4.9%】National Bureau of Statistics chief statistician Dong Lijuan said June national CPI fell 0.3% MoM. International price swings drove domestic gold jewelry and gasoline down 8.7% and 4.9%, widening their declines by 5.9 and 4.6 ppt vs. last month and together subtracting about 0.22 ppt from CPI—around 0.19 ppt more drag than in the prior month. Food prices fell 0.4% MoM, unchanged from May, trimming roughly 0.07 ppt off CPI. Seasonal supply pushed fresh vegetables and fruit down 1.0% and 2.0% (combined -0.06 ppt); pork and aquatic products fell 0.8% and 0.6% (combined -0.02 ppt). Egg prices rose 7.0% as low layer stocks and heat reduced lay rates, adding about 0.03 ppt to MoM CPI.

【NBS: Imported factors curb domestic industrial consumer-goods price growth】China June CPI +1.0% YoY, down 0.2ppt from May, NBS urban office chief statistician Dong Lijuan said. Industrial consumer-goods prices rose 2.9% YoY, 1.0ppt slower as international imported factors weighed; industrial consumer goods contributed about 0.90ppt to CPI YoY, a reduction of ~0.28ppt versus May. Within industrial goods, gold jewelry and gasoline decelerated to +28.1% and +17.0%, together adding ~0.60ppt to CPI YoY (down ~0.23ppt). Personal-care products and household appliances rose 2.3% and 2.2% YoY, both slower. Services inflation held at +0.8% YoY, contributing roughly 0.40ppt to CPI.

【China NBS: June factory-gate prices — producer goods down 0.3% MoM】China's National Bureau of Statistics said June factory-gate prices: producer goods (production materials) fell 0.3% MoM, cutting the overall PPI by about 0.25 percentage point. 【國家統計局：6月份食品菸酒及在外餐飲類價格環比下降0.3%】國家統計局資料顯示，6月份，食品菸酒及在外餐飲類價格環比下降0.3%，影響CPI下降約0.08個百分點。食品中，鮮果價格下降2.0%，影響CPI下降約0.04個百分點；鮮菜價格下降1.0%，影響CPI下降約0.02個百分點；畜肉類價格下降0.5%，影響CPI下降約0.02個百分點，其中豬肉價格下降0.8%；蛋類價格上漲5.8%，影響CPI上漲約0.03個百分點。其他七大類價格環比一漲兩平四降。其中，醫療保健價格上漲0.2%；居住、教育文化娛樂價格均持平；其他用品及服務、交通通訊價格分別下降2.7%和1.3%，生活用品及服務、衣著價格分別下降0.2%和0.1%。

【Ex-BOJ official says terminal rate could exceed 2% in current tightening cycle】Former BOJ official Watanabe Tsutomu said on Wednesday the BOJ could accelerate rate hikes later this year and lift its policy rate above 2% to rein in inflation. He said the terminal peak will likely be higher than most expect, around 2% or slightly above. Watanabe urged a dynamic assessment of policy, saying the terminal rate depends not only on neutral-rate estimates but also on factors such as inflation overshooting before the BOJ clearly tightens. With core inflation approaching the 2% target, he warned the policy board may shift from a previously passive stance to a more proactive position to prevent an overshoot.

【Citigroup: Bank of Korea likely to hike next week; 25bp each quarter in H2 2026】Citigroup economist Jin-Wook Kim says the Bank of Korea will raise the policy rate from 2.50% to 2.75% at next week’s meeting and is likely to signal a gradual hiking path. He expects the governor to indicate 25bp hikes each quarter in H2 2026 while remaining data-dependent and offering no specific guidance for H1 2027. Kim adds the Bank may flag upside risks to its 2026 growth forecast after an upward revision to Q1 growth and resilient Q2 activity.

【UBS: Australian gold miners' production strong but cost concerns persist】UBS said recent updates from Australian gold miners focused on FY2026 production and cash performance and were broadly ahead of its expectations. The bank said it has yet to see FY2027 guidance and, given high input prices, the Middle East conflict and persistent industry inflation, market cost expectations remain too low. UBS expects FY2027 industry all-in sustaining costs (AISC) to rise about A$150/oz and said cost inflation will be a key theme in upcoming annual guidance. UBS continues to favour Newmont and Capricorn Metals for high-quality, defensive exposure and stronger margins.

【鑑於通脹上升經濟加速 韓國央行認為有必要加息】韓國央行重申，政策利率需要在適當的時候上調。這進一步強化了其鷹派立場，而就在一週後，政策制定者將開會決定是否恢復緊縮政策。週四提交給國會的報告顯示，韓國央行表示這一轉變反映出，經濟增長增強、通脹高於目標水平以及金融穩定風險不斷上升，這些因素越來越不利於維持借貸成本不變。該報告呼應了央行自5月份以來的鷹派轉變。當時，央行將2026年經濟增長預期上調至2.6%，並暗示通脹、增長、匯率和金融失衡等因素正日益指向同一政策方向。市場普遍預期韓國央行將在7月16日的會議上將基準利率上調至2.75%。

【格雷厄姆.普拉特納因性侵指控暫停緬因州參議員競選】民主黨候選人格雷厄姆.普拉特納(Graham Platner)表示，他將暫停緬因州參議員競選，從而結束了這場雖獲得廣泛基層支援卻飽受爭議的競選活動。普拉特納在週三晚間釋出的一段影片中宣佈了退選決定。他在影片中指責媒體和政治建制派充當了“法官、陪審團和劊子手”，並繼續強烈否認針對他的指控。“我們暫停競選活動，”普拉特納說。他還表示，他將提交檔案正式退選，從而使該黨能夠在選票上換上新的名字。就在普拉特納做出退選決定的幾天前，一名曾與普拉特納有過戀愛關係的女子公開指控他性侵。儘管普拉特納對此予以否認，但這一指控仍促使參議院高層議員和他的親密盟友撤回背書、切斷資金支援，並呼籲他退出競選。

【美國馬里蘭州發生嚴重車禍 已致33人受傷】當地時間7月8日，美國馬里蘭州巴爾的摩縣消防部門表示，該縣派克斯維爾地區發生一起嚴重交通事故。一輛公交車與12輛汽車相撞，並撞及建築物，已造成33人受傷，目前所有傷者已被送往醫院。官方稱，事故涉及一輛馬里蘭州交通管理局公交車和多輛汽車。由於傷者較多，當局宣佈這是一起大規模傷亡事件，並調派15輛救護車、醫療救援直升機以及“休克創傷急救小組”趕赴現場。來自周邊縣的醫療救護巴士也參與救援。

【解放軍和武警部隊官兵、民兵持續投入搶險救災】解放軍報南寧7月8日電 受今年第10號颱風“美莎克”影響，連日來廣西多地遭遇極端強降雨，引發洪澇災害。南寧、貴港等地多座水庫出現險情，部分鄉鎮及城區發生嚴重內澇。面對複雜災情，解放軍和武警部隊官兵、民兵持續投入搶險救災，並開展災後恢復工作。 8日0時至4時，貴港市港南區瓦塘鎮武思江水位持續超警，洪峰過境形勢嚴峻。南部戰區陸軍千餘名官兵緊急馳援，對堤壩展開不間斷巡查，封堵加固隱患點位。廣西軍區出動官兵、民兵4600餘名，搜尋被困人員，巡查堤壩、水庫等重點區域。武警貴港支隊連夜抽調兵力，聯合地方力量開展隱患排查、組織群眾撤離。 南寧橫州市洪峰過境後，針對六藍水庫下游相關區域道路受阻等情況，南寧警備區組織民兵清淤除障；武警廣西總隊抽調600餘名官兵，幫助轉移、安置受災群眾。目前，受災群眾生產生活秩序穩步恢復。

Japanese Shares Rise on Tech Rebound — The Nikkei 225 Index jumped 2% to above 68,000 while the broader Topix Index gained 0.4% to 4,022 on Thursday, as Japanese equities snapped a two-day losing streak on the back of a rebound in technology stocks. Domestic shares also took cues from gains in US chipmakers and memory-related stocks overnight. Market sentiment was further supported by reports that South Korean chipmaker SK Hynix’s US listing was more than seven times oversubscribed, highlighting strong investor demand for artificial intelligence infrastructure. Meanwhile, US private equity firm Bain Capital sold its entire stake in Japanese flash memory producer Kioxia Holdings, although the company’s shares surged more than 7% during the session. Among other major technology gainers, Murata Manufacturing climbed 4%, Advantest advanced 6.9%, Tokyo Electron rose 4%, and Fujikura gained 5.1%.

【Zhongjin Lingnan unit commissions Ganzhou high‑energy composite metal electroplating plant in Jiangxi】Zhongjin Lingnan unit Zhongjin Technology began production on July 6 at a Ganzhou high‑energy composite metal electroplating project in the Xinyu electroplating centralized control zone, Jiangxi province. The facility uses a continuous localized electroplating process covering pre‑treatment, nickel underplate, masked localized tin plating and post‑treatment; coating thickness tolerance is controlled within ±0.5μm and product performance is benchmarked to industry‑leading levels.

Indonesia Motorbike Sales Rise 1.1% in June — Motorbike sales in Indonesia climbed 1.1% year-on-year to 515,136 units in June 2026, rebounding from a 5.1% fall in the previous month. The increase came despite persistent cost pressures. For the first half of the year, motorbike sales were 0.3% lower than in the same period last year, reaching 3.13 million units. The Association of Indonesian Motorcycle Industry (AISI) expects sales to remain relatively stable at around 6.4 million to 6.7 million units this year. Last year, motorbike sales grew 1.3% to 6.4 million units, within the target range of 6.4 million to 6.7 million units set by AISI. However, the growth rate was slightly slower than the 1.5% increase recorded in 2024. On a monthly basis, motorbike sales increased 7.5% in June, recovering from an 8.0% decline in May.

Australian Stocks Slip for Fourth Session — Australian shares dipped 73 points or 0.8% to 8,711 in early deals on Thursday, sliding for the fourth straight session amid weakness in most sectors, notably non-energy minerals, healthcare, process industries, and financials. Nerves persisted ahead of June CPI and PPI data in main trading partner China later in the day. Locally, Reserve Bank Assistant Governor Sarah Hunter warned that if inflation expectations rise, restoring stability may require “some period of low inflation and higher unemployment.” Still, losses were capped by U.S. stock futures that edged higher following a mixed session on Wall Street overnight as geopolitical tensions and rising oil prices weighed on sentiment. The four big banks lost between 0.8% and 1.4% while other notable decliners included heavyweight BHP Group (-1.6%), Pro Medicus (-2.7%), Wisetech Global (-2.1%), and Sonic Healthcare (-1.8%). In contrast, energy names gained, such as Woodside Energy (1.2%) and Santos (0.9%).

【上半年韓國農林畜水產品及食品價格兩位數上漲】韓國國家資料處7月9日釋出的消費者物價統計顯示，今年上半年黃花魚價格同比上漲16.9%，漲幅居主要農林畜水產品前列。分析認為，國際油價上漲推高了韓國漁船的燃油成本，部分漁船因此減少出海或暫停作業，導致國產黃花魚供應減少，價格隨之走高。與此同時，大米、人參和土豆價格同比分別上漲15.1%、14.6%和10.5%。進口芒果價格上漲13.1%，主要原因是異常天氣導致產量下降，加之韓元貶值推高了進口成本。不過，部分蔬菜價格明顯回落，胡蘿蔔、捲心菜、白蘿蔔、韭菜、梨、洋蔥和白菜價格同比分別下降37.8%、35%、33.7%、21.4%、20.9%、19.8%和18.5%。高油價和高匯率不僅推高了農產品價格，也帶動加工食品和餐飲價格上漲。加工食品中，鱈魚乾價格同比上漲15.1%，漲幅居首；韓式辣椒醬、醃海產品和醃蘿蔔價格分別上漲12.1%、10.5%和10.4%，大醬和醬油的漲幅也均超過8%。業內分析認為，進口原材料價格上漲、能源成本增加以及塑膠包裝成本上升，是加工食品漲價的主要原因。

【MOFCOM, eight ministries back listings for eligible new high-quality retail firms】MOFCOM and eight other ministries issued guidance to accelerate retail-sector innovation and provide financing support. Key measures: back IPOs for eligible new, high-quality retail firms; permit qualified retail operators to issue asset-backed securities (ABS) and commercial REITs; encourage financial institutions to offer retail-tailored industry credit policies; extend service-sector loan interest-subsidy schemes to eligible retail borrowers. The guidance also supports eligible department stores, shopping centers, community retail and wet-market projects issuing infrastructure REITs, and calls for increased financing for energy-saving, decarbonization and digital upgrades of facilities and equipment, subject to legal compliance and controllable risk.

【銀河證券：沙特原油碼頭恢復作業，歐對美天然氣進口下降】中信建投研報表示，沙特重要原油碼頭恢復作業。沙特阿美拉斯塔努拉原油碼頭於6月26日恢復裝載作業，該港自3月初起受地緣衝突及霍爾木茲海峽通行受限影響停擺，原油此前只能繞道紅海延布港外運。歐盟對美液化天然氣進口降至兩年來最低水平。因歐洲基準TTF價格為每百萬英熱單位13.19美元，低於亞洲基準17.33美元，美國LNG大量轉向亞洲及埃及市場。據LSEG資料，6月歐洲買家進口美國LNG不足此前一半；而歐盟去年7月已與美國簽署貿易協議，承諾三年內採購7500億美元美國能源商品。與此同時歐盟天然氣庫存跌至15年來冬季最低水平，中東局勢與卡達供應中斷加劇短缺，歐洲買家卻因擔憂過度依賴單一供應商而回避長期協議。有智庫預測歐盟液化天然氣進口對美依賴度未來將升至80%，高於去年的58%。

【韓國股市KOSPI指數上漲 晶片製造商SK海力士和三星電子反彈】韓國股市KOSPI指數上漲高達4.1%，收窄本週跌幅，晶片製造商股價反彈，儘管美伊緊張局勢再度升級且油價上漲。SK海力士和三星電子分別上漲9.2%和5.1%，成為指數上漲最大推動力。“人工智慧AI投資的理念正在實時演變，”中信里昂證券韓國的分析師Jongmin Shim表示，“鑑於當前AI部署週期仍處於早期階段，加上未來十年物理AI和人形機器人相關需求的預期，我們認為半導體需求在可預見的未來不太可能出現顯著的結構性放緩。”

【MOFCOM and eight ministries push digital RMB for consumer voucher issuance and settlement】MOFCOM and eight ministries issued guidance to accelerate retail-sector innovation, including promoting use of the digital RMB for consumer voucher issuance and settlement. The guidance calls for leveraging digital RMB smart contracts to enable more efficient circulation and precise, rapid delivery of subsidy funds. It backs full-chain digitization of retail operators—procurement, inventory, logistics and online-offline integration—and encourages platforms and third‑party tech vendors to provide digital management systems and shared resources to small and medium retailers. The document also promotes AI+ applications such as intelligent shopping assistance, low-altitude delivery and unmanned vending.

【全國首個海陸一體柔直工程換流站啟運】記者從南方電網瞭解到，我國首個海陸一體海上風電柔直輸電工程迎來關鍵節點，工程核心樞紐——海上換流站開始發運，預計一週後到達廣東陽江。在江蘇南通振華碼頭，陽江三山島海上風電專案的海上換流站正式裝船出發，船隊將航行近1000海里，抵達廣東陽江深海作業區完成海上就位安裝。這座海上換流站體量龐大，整體高度43米，相當於15層樓高，單層平臺面積接近一個標準足球場。（央視）

US Futures Steady Amid Iran Strikes — US stock futures stabilized on Thursday as investors assessed the impact of escalating tensions in the Middle East after the US military confirmed it had carried out strikes on Iran for a second straight day. Markets remain concerned that higher energy prices could reignite inflationary pressures and prompt the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates sooner than previously expected. In regular trading on Wednesday, the Dow and S&P 500 fell 1.09% and 0.28%, respectively, while the Nasdaq Composite edged up 0.2%. Materials, financials, and real estate were the weakest-performing sectors, whereas energy and technology stocks posted gains. Investors are now awaiting the latest weekly jobless claims and existing home sales figures for fresh clues on the interest rate outlook. Earnings reports from PepsiCo, Progressive, Cintas, and other major companies are also due.

【資料中心建設熱潮提振航空貨運需求】人工智慧(AI)基礎設施建設所需的笨重伺服器機架和薄如晶圓的半導體，正佔據著貨機上的艙位，而此前這些空間主要用於運輸低價服裝和各類小商品包裹。為推動全美資料中心的快速建設，企業正支付高昂運費從亞洲空運物資，而不是等待速度較慢、價格較低的海運。這種需求正在推高航空貨運量，與此同時，美國更高的關稅正侵蝕著廉價電商包裹市場，這些包裹在過去幾年裡曾充斥著貨運網路。“航空貨運市場似乎在逆勢上揚，”物流分析公司Xeneta的首席航空貨運官Niall van de Wouw說，“目前最大的增長引擎是與AI相關的一切。”國際航空運輸協會(International Air Transport Association)的資料顯示，5月份從亞洲到北美的航空貨運量較上年同期增長近20%。全球貨運量整體增長6%。美國商務部的資料顯示，5月份美國商品進口額增至3,170億美元，較上年同期增長15%，這是因為美國進口了更多半導體和計算機配件等與AI建設相關的商品。“關鍵的驅動因素是各方正爭分奪秒地推動新算力上線，”貨運代理公司Kuehne + Nagel International的雲基礎設施和半導體戰略全球主管羅.夏爾馬(Ro Sharma)說。由於需求增加，加之伊朗戰爭導致航空燃油價格走高，在通常是航空貨運淡季的時期，運費卻出現了上漲。Xeneta的資料顯示，6月份從亞太地區到北美的航空貨運平均即期運費較上年同期攀升36%。

【NVIDIA lags peers YTD; BofA says market overreacting】NVIDIA has materially underperformed the broader chip sector year-to-date, but BofA calls the weakness a more attractive buy than a risk signal. Analyst Vivek Arya concedes real investor concerns — notably rising HBM costs — but says the market has overreacted and underestimated NVIDIA's pricing power, scale and roughly $119 bln of supply commitments. He expects next‑generation Rubin pricing could be meaningfully higher than current Blackwell products, allowing the company to offset higher HBM costs and sustain gross margins in the mid‑70s pct range. Arya also downplays custom‑chip competition (e.g., Google/Broadcom TPU), noting TPU has existed for >10 years while NVIDIA GPU revenue grew ~700x; he projects NVIDIA will capture about 65–70% of hyperscaler AI infrastructure spend over the long term. NVIDIA trades at a forward P/E of ~18.69x, roughly half its 10‑year average and near an 11‑year trough.

【OpenAI最強模型GPT-5.6週四亮相 美國政府審查後放行】OpenAI將於週四正式釋出其最先進的人工智慧(AI)模型GPT-5.6。此前由於美國政府基於國家安全疑慮，擔心強大AI技術可能遭到濫用，該模型上個月在政府要求下推遲釋出。專家指出，這類技術可能大幅提升複雜網路攻擊的能力，尤其是在那些依賴高度互聯、且往往已有數十年曆史的技術系統領域中。華盛頓已加強對先進AI模型釋出的審查力度，以識別潛在威脅。率先披露OpenAI新模型釋出訊息的Axios報導稱，在經過額外測試以及與政府官員舉行多場會議後，特朗普政府已批准GPT-5.6的全面釋出。此前，OpenAI僅向少數透過稽核的合作伙伴開放GPT-5.6，且相關合作伙伴名單已提供給政府主管機關。OpenAI週二夜晚在X平臺發文表示，將推出效能最強大的GPT-5.6 Sol，以及成本較低的Terra和Luna模型。

【殷勇在朝陽區圍繞加快建設全球數字經濟標杆城市調研，要求做強底層技術、拓展應用場景，不斷培育壯大新質生產力】7月8日，北京市委副書記、市長殷勇在朝陽區圍繞加快建設全球數字經濟標杆城市開展調研。他強調，要搶抓未來產業新賽道，持續集聚高精尖產業創新主體，做強底層技術、拓展應用場景，不斷培育壯大新質生產力，推動全球數字經濟標杆城市建設提質增效，為首都高質量發展注入強勁動能。殷勇在調研時強調，要完善產業協同創新生態，聚焦關鍵領域，發揮創新平臺作用，推動頭部企業聯動上下游中小企業、高校科研院所等組建創新聯合體，深化產學研協同攻關，集中力量破解技術難題。充分釋放北京場景資源優勢，推動人工智慧、量子計算等前沿技術在垂直領域示範應用，以場景牽引技術迭代、賦能產業壯大。市有關部門和區要完善從基礎研究、中試量產到商業化落地的全鏈條支援體系，強化資金、人才等要素供給保障，精準施策解決企業在融資上市、成果轉化、場景落地、生態建設等方面訴求，助力企業做大做強。

【Trump says Iran called, eager to reach a deal】On July 9 aboard Air Force One returning to the United States, President Trump told reporters Iran had just called and was "very eager" to reach an agreement, though he said he was unsure whether it "deserved" one. He said the US has "already won militarily" and Iran "has nothing left," and when asked why Iran would attack merchant ships if it seeks a deal he said they are "a bit crazy, out of control" but still eager for a deal.

【生豬價格反彈 部分概念股估值已處於低位】近期，豬價迎來一波顯著反彈。生意社價格顯示，7月8日生豬價格漲至11.02元/公斤，近8日持續上漲，自3月5日以來首次回升至11元上方。4月中旬以來，生豬價格震盪上行，最新價格較4月中旬的低價上漲逾22%。近期豬價持續上漲，主要受到行業產能去化、政策持續加碼穩定豬價等方面影響。產能層面，國家統計局資料顯示，3月末能繁母豬存欄量為3904萬頭，同比減少135萬頭，但仍較今年農業農村部劃定的最新調控目標3750萬頭高出154萬頭，產能有進一步下降的空間。當前豬價持續承壓，頭部豬企透過雙管齊下的方式，一方面最佳化飼料配方，降低期間費用等極致降本方式，另一方面主動放緩出欄節奏，下調年度出欄目標增速，保障現金流。據證券時報·資料寶統計，A股中佈局生豬養殖的概念股超20只，年初以來平均下跌19.64%。部分概念股估值已處於低位。
【特朗普稱伊朗致電迫切想達成協議】美國總統特朗普今天（7月9日）在搭乘“空軍一號”專機返回美國途中對隨行媒體稱，“伊朗剛剛打電話來，他們非常迫切地想要達成一項協議。只不過我不知道他們是否還配得上達成協議。”特朗普稱，“美國在軍事上已經贏了，伊朗什麼都不剩了。” 在被問到“如果伊朗迫切想達成協議，為什麼還要攻擊商船”時，特朗普稱，“因為他們有點瘋狂，失控了——但他們非常迫切地想要達成協議。”

Brent Extends Gains as US Strikes Continue — Brent climbed toward $79 per barrel on Thursday and was up nearly 10% for the week, after the US military confirmed it had carried out strikes on Iran for a second straight day, intensifying tensions and fueling concerns over energy supplies from the Middle East. The US said the attacks were intended to reduce Iran’s ability to threaten navigation through the Strait of Hormuz, while Tehran vowed a large-scale retaliatory campaign against US military bases across the region. President Donald Trump declared that, in his view, the ceasefire is over and warned of additional military action against Iran, including a new blockade. He also cautioned that oil prices could climb further and said future strikes may target Iran’s key export terminal on Kharg Island. The renewed hostilities have heightened fears that the collapse of the interim US-Iran peace agreement could once again disrupt global oil supplies, with the Strait of Hormuz remaining at the center of the conflict.

【在對中東供應干擾的擔憂之際，油價上漲】在對中東供應干擾的擔憂之際，亞洲早盤油價上漲。根據美國中央司令部的訊息，美軍週三晚間對伊朗發動了新的打擊，而幾個小時前，美國總統特朗普宣佈結束為期八週的停火。XS.com的Samer Hasn在一封電子郵件中表示，最新油價上漲正值“市場再次認識到目前停火的脆弱性，以及中東戰爭尚未結束“之際。該高階市場分析師補充道：“石油供應干擾的風險依然很高，透過外交途徑解決問題的道路仍然非常漫長。“近月西得州中質油期貨上漲1.3%，報每桶74.47美元。

【韓媒：韓國官員稱韓元走弱只是短期現象】韓國經濟日報援引韓國總統政策室長金容範（Kim Yong-beom）週三在一場論壇上的發言報道，當前美元兌韓元匯率走高只是 “暫時性現象”，韓國後續或將迎來韓元升值壓力。金容範表示，三星電子、SK 海力士股價大漲後外資隨即獲利了結，但這些企業賺取的美元回款兌換成韓元需要數年週期，這是造成韓元短期貶值的原因。他透露，韓國正就匯率問題商討國際合作事宜，同時與三星、SK 海力士展開溝通；韓國將先評估外匯儲備規模是否充足，並以此為起點研究各類應對方案。談及人工智慧時代的能源政策，金容範還提出，韓國應儘可能多建設核電站。

【港股迎估值修復視窗 公募加大布局力度】經歷近6個月的持續調整後，港股市場整體估值持續回落，在此背景下，公募開始加大對港股市場的佈局力度，不少基金開始廣泛佈局從港股科技、網際網路到消費的各類資產。7月8日，港股市場迎來大幅反彈，恒生指數單日上漲2.99%，恒生科技指數漲幅高達4.97%。此前，因AI技術替代敘事的SaaS、移動網際網路、軟體企業成為領漲力量，多隻公募基金重倉股漲幅亮眼。港股的復甦跡象也並不僅是科網股賽道，對比A股市場偏好科技成長風格，佈局港股的公募基金更加看重持續穩定的現金流，也讓港股消費在調整後的彈性並不弱於科技資產。此前，受A股科技行情虹吸效應的影響，港股優質消費股股價持續下探，多家公募基金近期開始逆向佈局，在近期市場反彈之前便透過南向資金入場，主動佈局消費賽道龍頭。
【伊朗一機場遭美軍襲擊 】據伊朗官方通訊社伊通社報道，伊朗東部錫斯坦－俾路支斯坦省副省長證實，伊朗沙赫爾機場當地時間今天（7月9日）凌晨遭美軍襲擊，一名消防員殉職。他表示，當地連續4次傳出劇烈爆炸聲，機場的飛行保障設施大樓和氣象站被擊中，建築損壞。

【車船稅徵收政策明年調整 新能源汽車發展重心轉移】財政部、稅務總局、工業和資訊化部日前釋出了《關於調整節能汽車新能源汽車車船稅優惠政策的公告》，明確自2027年1月1日起，取消對節能汽車減半徵收車船稅政策，取消對插電式（含增程式）混合動力汽車等免徵車船稅政策。記者採訪獲悉，截至2025年底，全國新能源汽車保有量達4397萬輛，佔汽車總量的12.01%。隨著國內新能源汽車滲透率的持續提升，汽車行業發展已進入新階段，但在高速發展的同時也呈現冷熱不均的現象。業內專家對記者表示，純電動、氫燃料電池零排放乘用車是我國汽車新能源化發展的長期戰略核心，將持續享受制度紅利與政策託底；插混、增程、節能油混等搭載內燃機的過渡技術，產業培育期已經告一段落。（上海證券報）

【US media: Iran attack on ships during NATO summit angered Trump】CNN, citing a US official, reports Trump decided Wednesday night to order a new round of strikes on Iran, partly because the Strait of Hormuz had not fully reopened and because Iran attacked vessels transiting the strait while he was at the NATO summit. The official said the timing — an attack while Trump met other leaders — particularly provoked him; Trump said he had lost patience with the pace of nuclear talks, accused Tehran of lying and breaking agreements, and called the nuclear issue '99.9%' of his work.

【多家算力產業鏈公司上半年業績預增】近期，A股算力產業鏈多家上市公司釋出2026年上半年業績預告，業績表現亮眼。據記者不完全統計，截至7月8日，已有20多家算力產業鏈上市公司上半年業績預增。記者梳理發現，AI大模型商業化落地帶動算力採購與租賃需求持續釋放，進而推動硬體、儲存及算力服務環節的盈利能力同步提升。天風證券認為，算力作為人工智慧產業的核心基礎資源，其配套的算力租賃行業，已成為支撐AI產業穩步發展的關鍵賽道，看好2026年國內AI基礎設施需求延續高景氣，以及算力產業鏈核心標的的投資機會。（上海證券報）

【貝恩資本高位清倉快閃記憶體晶片廠商鎧俠 八年前的投資斬獲創紀錄回報】貝恩資本已賣出其所持快閃記憶體晶片製造商鎧俠的全部股份，一項改變了日本科技和投資格局的交易就此翻篇。“我們不再持有任何鎧俠股份，”貝恩的管理合夥人David Gross在接受媒體採訪時表示。得益於全球人工智慧投資熱潮，鎧俠股價自其上市以來上漲了超過4000%，使得這家晶片製造商成為日本市值最高的公司之一，貝恩也獲得了創紀錄的回報。“這對所有相關利益方來說都非常成功，”Gross說。在貝恩資本清倉前，其截至6月中旬的持股比例已從去年12月的約44%降至約14%。它的退出也正值市場對人工智慧相關天價估值疑慮升溫之際。全球半導體股今年一度創下新高，但隨後因市場擔憂競爭加劇、產能可能過剩以及數千億美元投資的回報前景而陷入動盪。

【純苯期貨期權上市一週年 化工產業風險管理閉環穩步構建】2025年7月8日，純苯期貨和期權在大連商品交易所掛牌上市，如今已滿一週年。純苯作為有機化工的基礎原料，期貨工具上市被視作行業從“粗放博弈”向“精細化管理”轉型的關鍵節點，能與已上市的苯乙烯等期貨品種形成聯動，打造產業鏈風險管理閉環。記者近期走訪多家化工龍頭企業獲悉，純苯期貨和期權已逐步融入產業鏈的日常運營。尤其是2026年上半年，中東地緣衝突引發全球化工品價格劇烈波動，部分生產企業利用“純苯-苯乙烯”的跨品種套保組合，鎖定苯乙烯裝置的遠期加工利潤，保障企業穩定經營。（上海證券報）

【賺錢效應明顯 多路資金搶籌基石投資】智譜漲逾10倍、深演智慧漲逾6倍、兆易創新H股漲近4倍……年內上市的港股新股表現亮眼，吸引外資機構、保險資金、銀行理財子公司、公募基金及產業資本等競相透過基石投資佈局。據Choice資料統計，截至7月8日，年內91家港股IPO公司中，引入基石投資者的佔了81.32%，較往年進一步提升。參與港股打新的基石投資者多達502家，大部分IPO引入5家及以上基石投資者。深圳市金融穩定發展研究院輪值院長董耀徽表示，上半年積極參與港股IPO的基石投資者中，外資、險資等長線資金的佔比尤其大，這些型別的資金體量龐大、負債端久期長，其踴躍參與意味著對港股優質資產長期配置價值的認可，也為新股上市後的股價表現提供了重要的安全墊。

【船企訂單排至2030年 產業迎來確定性上行機遇】依託全球造船產業復甦浪潮，國內造船產業正迎來確定性上行機遇。恆力重工上半年新籤船舶訂單207艘，累計在手訂單突破500艘，交船排期已鎖定至2030年；中國船舶交船週期同樣排至2030年；蘇美達2026年一季度新獲訂單同比暴漲超600%。整體上，國內頭部船企訂單普遍飽滿，行業紅利正在釋放。高景氣週期之下，潛在風險也值得關注。分析人士指出，需警惕樂觀下的過快擴產。此外，貿易政策擾動、細分需求分化、燃料技術短板等變數，或將制約行業上行空間與盈利水平。

【假冒券商薦股新型詐騙頻發 調查發現“四步詐騙法”】在AI技術逐漸普及的背景下，不法分子仿冒券商APP實施詐騙、侵害投資者合法權益的騙局持續高發。金融街證券官微上週通報稱，近期北京警方發現有不法分子仿冒該公司旗下金融街證券APP，誘導使用者開啟“共享螢幕”功能等方式實施詐騙。證券時報記者梳理發現，自去年以來，遭遇APP仿冒、偽造身份詐騙的券商多達30餘家，廣發證券、方正證券、中信建投等頭部機構均在列，上述券商已陸續釋出公告，提醒公眾警惕假冒機構、假冒從業人員開展的非法證券活動。2026年初，浙江溫州一位投資者向監管部門遞交了一封長達數頁的舉報信。信中詳細記錄了他如何被一個自稱“廣發證券內部拉昇群”的團伙，在不到一個月的時間裡騙走6.6萬元本金以及賬面盈利15萬元。這並非孤例。華南某券商披露的內部資料顯示，2025年該公司接到假冒案件線索超過1900條,同比增長280%，涉案金額高達3000萬元，總部來訪受害投資者達150人次。證券時報記者調查發現，這類詐騙早已不是零散隨機作案，而是形成一套環環相扣、融合心理操控與AI技術應用的完整犯罪鏈條，並演化出標準化的“四步詐騙法”。第一步：不法分子精準引流；第二步：偽造券商員工身份；第三步：打造虛假券商APP；第四步：收割跑路。

【格陵蘭島自治政府總理重申該島“不出售”】當地時間7月8日，格陵蘭島自治政府總理尼爾森再次表示，格陵蘭島不出售。美國總統特朗普7日在土耳其首都安卡拉與土耳其總統埃爾多安舉行雙邊會議前，再次聲稱格陵蘭島“應該由美國控制”，而不是丹麥。對此，尼爾森表示，反覆要求接管或控制格陵蘭的言論不會改變這一立場。格陵蘭島是丹麥自治領地。特朗普2025年重返白宮以來，多次揚言要得到格陵蘭島，甚至聲稱不排除動用武力，致使美國與丹麥及更多歐洲盟友關係緊張。

【Greenland premier reiterates island 'not for sale'】Greenland premier Kielsen said on July 8 the island is not for sale, rejecting U.S. President Trump’s July 7 remark in Ankara before a meeting with Turkish President Erdogan that Greenland should be controlled by the United States rather than Denmark. Kielsen said repeated calls to take over or control Greenland would not change that position.

【用好投研人力資源 公募機構探索基金經理“新管理模式”】公募基金行業正在形成對投研“人力資源”的“新管理模式”。記者近期在調研基金公司投研團隊建設時發現，公募基金行業正在逐漸形成新的共識：既然行業已經告別“明星基金經理”，強化業績基準對投資的約束作用，強調團隊化和平臺化的投研架構，那麼，在投資者一端，也希望建立新的邏輯：買基金是買產品，買產品背後的投資能力。順著這樣的邏輯鏈條，在基金公司一側，也在同步進行變化：基金公司正在成為“人力資源公司”——它要為合適的產品安排合適的基金經理，要為合適的市場環境安排合適的基金產品和基金經理……探索新模式，需要面對新的考驗。“以後基金公司需要對基金經理及其背後的投資能力進行組合和排布，這對基金公司的專業性提出了很高要求。基金公司管理團隊的專業性首當其衝。”一位基金公司總經理表示。（中國證券報）
【Kalshi交易員預測：受最新挫折影響，霍爾木茲海峽航運要到2027年才能恢復正常】據預測市場平臺Kalshi上的交易員表示，霍爾木茲海峽的航運流量在2026年之前不太可能恢復正常。在美國總統特朗普宣佈與伊朗的停火協議“結束”後，恢復正常航運的機率大幅下降。

【特朗普威脅稱若伊朗繼續襲船 後果將“更嚴重” 】美軍8日宣佈對伊朗再次發動打擊後，美國總統特朗普威脅稱，如果伊朗繼續針對透過霍爾木茲海峽的船隻發動襲擊，美軍的報復性打擊將會“更嚴重”。特朗普8日在社交媒體發文：“這是對伊朗昨天轟炸船隻行為的報復。如果再次發生，後果將嚴重得多！”此前，美軍中央司令部在社交媒體釋出訊息說，美軍當天對伊朗實施更多打擊，以進一步削弱伊朗威脅霍爾木茲海峽航行的能力。這是美軍以回應伊朗近期襲擊霍爾木茲海峽商船為由，連續兩天對伊朗發動軍事打擊。

【今年以來255家企業評級按下終止鍵 債市資訊缺口亟待堵漏】Wind資料顯示，截至7月8日，今年以來已有255家發債企業終止評級，同比小幅攀升。這一現象背後，既有企業因債券到期摘牌或戰略調整的正常退出，也有為規避降級風險、掩蓋信用隱患的主動“斷舍離”。隨著評級這一重要資訊源缺失的情況增多，投資者面臨的資訊不對稱問題加劇，相關債券則面臨被移出資產池、二級市場利差走闊的風險。在監管部門嚴抓評級質量的背景下，如何堵住“終止評級”背後的漏洞，建立長效的信用監測機制，已成為維護債市健康發展的關鍵議題。（中國證券報）

【Trump says he 'saw through' Iran, does not expect large-scale, prolonged U.S.-Iran war】On July 8, at a press conference after the NATO summit, President Trump said he had "seen through" Iran and is "now uncertain whether to reach a deal with them" after earlier praising Iran's leadership. He said he is "at the top of Iran's assassination list" and added he does "not think the U.S. and Iran will erupt into a large-scale, prolonged war," saying any conflict would "end quickly."

【特朗普稱看透了伊朗 】7月8日，在北約峰會閉幕後的記者會上，美國總統特朗普被問及“為何上個月還在稱讚伊朗領導人非常理性、強硬聰明、很好打交道，如今卻指責其扭曲病態”。特朗普回應稱，因為他“看透了伊朗”，“現在不確定還要不要和他們達成協議”。在回答記者提問時，特朗普還稱自己是伊朗“刺殺名單上的榜首”。 特朗普還稱，他“不認為美伊會爆發大規模持久戰”，衝突會“快速結束”。

【特朗普：在美方發出貿易禁運威脅後，西班牙已同意增加支付款項】特朗普搭乘空軍一號從峰會返程美國途中向記者作出表態。“我跟他說了，我打算終止雙邊貿易，” 他接著說道，“對方此前按要求完成了大額款項支付，也兌現了相關付款要求；倘若他們沒有照做，我們根本不會和他們展開任何談判。”特朗普並未說明他所指的款項具體是什麼，也未透露自己對話的西班牙相關人員身份。但這位美國總統在週三早些時候抨擊了這位北約盟國，指責該國未在美國與以色列對伊朗採取軍事行動一事上提供支援，同時稱西班牙國防開支投入不足。特朗普在與北約秘書長馬克・呂特會面時表示：“爭取西班牙這邊的合作已經毫無意義。” 他還再次放出切斷貿易往來的狠話，稱 “我們不想再和西班牙開展任何貿易合作”。

UK Housing Market Remains Weak — The RICS UK Residential Market Survey showed that the house price balance edged up to -33% in June 2026 from -34% in May, pointing to only tentative signs of improvement despite the recent easing in global geopolitical tensions and the decline in oil prices. New buyer enquiries rose to -29% from -34%, the least negative reading since February, while the agreed sales balance improved to -32% from -35%, pointing to a gradual easing in market weakness. Meanwhile, new instructions to sell fell sharply to -23% from -10%, marking the weakest reading in over a year and signaling a tighter supply pipeline. Regionally, the South East and South West remained under the greatest price pressure, while Northern Ireland and Scotland continued to outperform. Looking ahead, the three-month house price expectations index improved to -32% from -44%, while the 12-month outlook turned slightly more optimistic at +8%, reflecting modest price growth over the coming year.

【防空反導、對海打擊 中俄展開海上聯合演習】昨天（8日），中俄“海上聯合-2026”聯合演習港岸階段順利結束。雙方艦艇將於今天（9日）上午從青島某軍港解纜起航，前往預定海域展開海上聯合演習。 出發前，聯合導演部、聯合指揮部組織多輪指揮推演和戰術協同，雙方指揮員商定作戰行動要點、演練規則，細化海上協同流程和應急處置預案。在海軍潛艇學院，中俄雙方任務官兵、相關專家聚焦援潛救生技術發展、裝備建設、海上訓練等議題展開專業交流。在軍港碼頭，中俄雙方互相開放艦艇，並圍繞艦艇的動力系統維護、遠洋航行經驗、日常訓練管理等方面展開討論。  （央視）

【在畢馬威接受調查之際  澳大利亞監管機構正在審查針對“四大”審計公司的投訴】澳大利亞企業監管機構週四表示，鑑於近期關於畢馬威（KPMG）審計師行為不當的指控，該機構已開始審查“四大”會計師事務所——畢馬威、德勤、安永和普華永道——收到的審計行為投訴。此次審查源於澳大利亞證券與投資委員會（ASIC）於6月針對畢馬威澳大利亞三名合夥人啟動的正式調查，該調查源於舉報人指控該公司濫用客戶機密資料以贏得利潤豐厚的審計合同。ASIC在宣告中表示，此次審查將調查各事務所收到的與所提供的外部審計服務相關的內部投訴，包括舉報人的投訴。ASIC週四還表示，將持續開展“針對畢馬威濫用客戶機密資訊的具體指控的重大調查”。“ASIC將運用現有的有限權力，同時繼續積極參與政府的改革程序，”ASIC主席莎拉·考特補充道。這四家審計公司尚未立即回應置評請求。

【SpaceX聯手Cursor釋出Grok 4.5】SpaceXAI週三釋出Grok 4.5大模型，主打程式碼編寫與智慧代理任務，將法律和金融服務納入目標應用場景。SpaceXAI表示，Grok 4.5依託數萬臺英偉達GB300 GPU完成訓練，AI程式設計初創公司Cursor將接入Grok 4.5模型用於程式碼開發。SpaceX上月宣佈將以全股票交易形式收購Cursor ，以此搶佔企業級AI工具賽道。作為競品，OpenAI 原計劃上月釋出旗艦大模型GPT-5.6，因美國政府出於AI技術濫用國家安全風險提出暫緩要求而延期。該模型將於本週四正式公開發布。

【AI chipmaker Positron in talks for about $750m financing; valuation could reach $5bn】AI chip startup Positron is in talks on a two-stage financing round targeting about $750m. 【穆迪稱儘管面臨支出風險 日本信用評級仍顯穩定】數萬億美元政府支出的前景已經衝擊日本債券和匯率市場，但至少目前尚未改變穆迪的看法。這家信用評級公司的主權風險部門副總裁Martin Petch並未對日本財政走向敲響警鐘，但他認為，日本首相高市早苗計劃在14年內向經濟投資逾370萬億日元（2.3萬億美元）的綱要需進一步明確。“目前，我們認為其評級相當穩定，”Petch接受採訪時表示。穆迪給予日本A1評級，為其第五高的投資級評級，展望穩定。“風險非常均衡。”

【旺季前置補庫行情見頂，業內人士稱集運期貨仍存回撥空間】前期一路“狂飆”的集運指數（歐線）期貨，近期踩下“急剎車”。文華財經資料顯示，自6月11日盤中創下4096點階段高點後，集運指數（歐線）期貨主力連續合約震盪回落，7月7日盤中最低觸及2412點，區間累計跌幅超四成。業內人士表示，前期集運指數（歐線）期貨強勢上漲，主要是由地緣衝突、運力受阻、燃油和保險成本抬升、旺季發運前置等因素共同推動。而近期高位回落，則與地緣風險邊際緩和、船公司新開艙報價不及市場預期、2026美加墨世界盃發運潮結束以及部分運力外溢有關。展望下半年，市場交易主線正由地緣風險、旺季需求形成的上行支撐，切換為受運力集中投放、終端需求走弱影響的下行壓制，歐線運價上行空間或受限制，中期走勢將偏弱。（中證報）

New Zealand Manufacturing Growth Strongest Since 2021 — The Business NZ Performance of Manufacturing Index in New Zealand increased to 54.7 in June, up from an upwardly revised 51.3 in May, marking the fifth consecutive month of expansion and well above the long-term average of 52.5. It was the strongest growth in factory activity since July 2021, with new orders being the standout at 64.1 (vs 53.2 in May), pointing to a healthy pipeline of work ahead. Meanwhile, production surged to 59.4 (vs 50.6), while deliveries rose to 57.3 (vs 52.9). Stocks of finished products (56.9 vs 54.3) and employment (55.8 vs 51.4) were also well above the 50.0 mark, an encouraging sign for manufacturing hiring. " There are still real headwinds with the conflict in the Middle East and high fuel prices continuing to be a factor for many respondents, but this month's result reflects a huge positive shift after a long stretch of soft results, which is a very welcome turn," said BusinessNZ’s Director of Advocacy, Catherine Beard.

【7月9日美股成交額前20：博通獲蘋果超300億美元晶片大單】週三美股成交額第7名博通收高4.83%，成交118.84億美元。當地時間7月8日，蘋果宣佈與博通達成一項協議，計劃未來五年向博通採購價值超過300億美元的美國製造晶片。根據協議，博通將在美國生產超過150億顆晶片，並在科羅拉多州柯林斯堡工廠投資15億美元擴建和升級產能，生產包括FBAR射頻濾波器在內的先進射頻元件及無線連線晶片。當地時間7月6日，博通公告，其與蘋果已同意透過簽訂新的多年期長期協議，將雙方的長期技術合作擴充套件至2031年，約定由博通開發和供應一系列定製的ASIC晶片產品，用於蘋果的多個終端產品。

【美國10年期實際收益率升至一年高位 強勁經濟與油價走高引發加息猜想】美國經通脹調整後的國債收益率升至逾一年來最高水平，因為油價上漲與經濟依然強勁的雙重因素，再次引發市場對美聯儲將在未來幾個月內開始加息的猜測。10年期美國通脹保值債券收益率週三升至約2.3%，為2025年4月以來最高水平。所謂實際收益率的上升增強了美元的吸引力，同時提高了持有黃金和加密貨幣等非生息資產的機會成本，從而對這些資產構成壓力。這一走勢反映出投資者相信，在人工智慧投資熱潮推動下，富有韌性的美國經濟將使美聯儲官員相信央行可以在不影響增長的情況下收緊貨幣政策。交易員週三上調了對美聯儲將在10月前加息的押注，因為美伊衝突再度升級推高了油價並引發通脹擔憂。道明證券美國利率策略主管Gennadiy Goldberg表示：“實際利率走高受到穩健的增長預期，以及市場擔憂美聯儲在中東衝突升級的情況下需要進一步收緊政策的共同推動。”

Argentina Industrial Output Falls in April — Argentina's industrial production fell 5.7% year-on-year in May 2026, following a 2.8% decline in April. Fourteen of the 16 manufacturing sectors posted annual declines. The largest drags came from machinery and equipment (-23.4%), food and beverages (-3.0%), motor vehicles and auto parts (-15.9%), apparel, leather and footwear (-14.7%), textiles (-26.2%), and chemicals (-3.1%). Other sectors posting declines included rubber and plastics (-10.2%), other equipment and instruments (-12.5%), basic metals (-4.0%), furniture and other manufacturing (-7.3%), wood, paper and printing (-2.9%), non-metallic minerals (-2.3%), other transport equipment (-9.9%), and metal products (-1.2%). In contrast, petroleum refining (19.4%) and tobacco products (14.6%) recorded solid growth. On a monthly basis, industrial production rose 0.4%.

【美聯儲傳聲筒：美聯儲分歧核心在通脹前景，而非政策方向】華爾街日報記者Nick Timiraos表示，美聯儲6月會議紀要顯示，官員之間的分歧主要來自對未來經濟走勢的不同判斷，而不是在加息或降息策略上存在根本衝突。美聯儲內部形成了兩種可能情景：如果通脹繼續居高不下，幾乎所有官員都認為需要維持更高利率，甚至進一步收緊政策；但如果通脹很快回落至2%的目標水平，幾乎所有官員也認為可以維持當前利率，甚至未來降息。他認為，“很快回落至2%”這一表述非常關鍵，為美聯儲保留了政策調整空間。目前官員們真正關注的問題是，通脹是否會持續反彈，還是重新進入下降軌道。Timiraos總結稱，美聯儲下一步行動仍取決於經濟資料，尤其是通脹表現。市場此前押注降息，但最新紀要顯示，政策前景仍存在較大不確定性。

【WSJ: Fed split driven by inflation outlook, not policy direction】WSJ reporter Nick Timiraos says the Fed’s June minutes show officials differ mainly on the inflation and economic outlook rather than on whether to tighten or ease policy. Officials outlined two scenarios: if inflation stays elevated, most favor maintaining higher rates or further tightening; if inflation quickly returns to 2%, most would be comfortable holding current rates and could consider cuts. Timiraos highlights the phrase “quickly returns to 2%” as key, preserving Fed flexibility. The minutes underscore that the Fed’s next moves will depend on incoming data—especially inflation—and that policy timing remains uncertain despite prior market bets on cuts.

US 10-Year Yield Extends Rebound — The yield on the 10-year US Treasury note rose up to the 4.60% mark on Wednesday, the highest since May, as higher energy prices magnified the impact of a hawkish Federal Reserve. Fuel prices soared after a new wave of attacks between the US and Iran reignited concerns that energy from the Middle East will be blockaded. The pro-inflationary risks were consistent with minutes from the FOMC's June meeting, which indicated that a few policymaker saw higher core inflation readings and a robust labor market making the case for a rate hike. Rate futures continued to show a loose consensus that the Fed is due to deliver one rate hike this year, although nearly half of the market was positioned for more than one hike. Bonds were also under pressure from Fed Chairman Warsh's earlier calls for a smaller balance sheet, to be achieved by trimming the central bank's holdings of longer-term notes and bonds.

【Fed minutes show clear split on rate path; both hikes and cuts seen as possible】Minutes of the Fed’s June 16–17 meeting show officials were sharply divided on the rate outlook. The Fed unanimously held the policy rate at 3.50%–3.75%, but some members said easing inf could create scope for cuts while others warned persistent price pressures could require further hikes. Officials disagreed on year‑end rates—some expected levels near or slightly below current, others expected rates above current. The Fed said future policy will be data‑dependent, with decisions to hinge on inf, employment and other economic data.

Fed Divided Over Interest Rate Outlook — Fed officials were divided on the future of interest rates and discussed a range of scenarios for the evolution of the economy and monetary policy, minutes from the FOMC meeting in June 2026 showed. Participants generally assessed that upside risks to inflation remained elevated and a few commented that, in light of these developments, there was a case for raising interest rates. Most participants also pointed to scenarios in which, in the context of stable labor market conditions, inflation would remain elevated due to strong AI-related demand, the conflict in the Middle East, or the effects of tariffs. In such scenarios, almost all of these participants indicated that some policy firming would likely be warranted to return inflation to 2%. However, under their most likely economic outlook, many officials expected interest rates to end the year at or slightly below their current level. The Fed kept the federal funds rate unchanged at 3.50%-3.75% in June, in line with expectations.

【Fed minutes: Majority back shortening statement, removal of 'easing bias'】June Fed minutes show officials considered KEVIN WARSH’s proposal to end forward guidance and trim references to future rate moves. A majority backed shortening the policy statement and supported deleting language that suggested the next move would likely be a cut. The June alternative approved by the Fed removed rate guidance entirely, consistent with Warsh’s aim to avoid committing on future rates. At the June meeting the Fed held the policy rate at 3.50%-3.75%; the dot plot showed nine of 18 officials expect rates to be slightly higher by end-2026, and markets widely saw the possibility of hikes this year.

【Federal Reserve minutes: Some participants said a hike could be necessary but backed keeping rates unchanged】Minutes from the Fed’s June 16–17 meeting show officials increasingly concerned about high inf. A minority judged an immediate rate hike could be warranted, but participants followed Fed chair KEVIN WARSH in issuing a shorter policy statement and ultimately supported leaving the policy rate unchanged. The minutes say a “majority of participants” saw scenarios in which inf would return to the Fed’s 2% target and scenarios in which it would remain elevated; “almost all” participants holding the latter view said hikes would be necessary if that occurred. Participants generally judged incoming information between meetings pointed to elevated upside risks to price stability and reduced downside risks to full employment.

Coal Hover Near 3-Month Low — Thermal coal futures from Australia fell to below $130 per tonne in July, not far from their lowest level since early March, as muted purchases from India offset a broader-based rebound for energy commodities. A weak rupee and an upgrade to the quantity of domestic production drove Indian utilities to extend its effort of reducing import dependency. This was combined with elevated levels of domestic inventories for the second-largest consumer to take in lower imports and soften bidding competition from other consumers. Still, energy commodities remained higher since March as fresh escalation between the US and Iran triggered another increase in power prices. LNG tankers held off from crossing the Strait of Hormuz after a vessel was struck by Iran. This supported the outlook that Japan and Korea, the main consumers of higher coal grades from Australia, are likely to maintain coal imports amid higher LNG prices.

The increase in crude oil prices was exacerbated by soaring crack spreads in distillate fuel as tight refining capacity drove energy companies to hike sales prices. On top of that, major diesel producer Russia announced it would halt exports and shift to an importer, as higher crude prices exacerbated the series of Ukrainian strikes on the country's largest refineries. Heating oil prices had dropped sharply since peaking at a record high of $4.7 after in late March, but recently rebounded to trade over 40% above levels from before the conflict.

Colombia Exports Jump Rise in May — Colombia's exports rose 19.2% year-on-year to USD 5.19 billion in May 2026 after increasing 11.7% in April. The gain was driven mainly by a 33.3% rise in fuel and mining exports, reflecting a 32.4% increase in shipments of petroleum and petroleum products. Agricultural, food, and beverage exports edged up 0.7%, supported by higher exports of cut flowers and foliage (24.9%) and coffee extracts, essences, and concentrates (89.2%). Manufactured exports rose 0.2%, led by chemicals and related products (8.0%) and machinery and transport equipment (12.6%). Exports from other sectors surged 67.0%, largely due to a sharp increase in non-monetary gold shipments. Meanwhile, crude oil exports totaled 11.4 million barrels, down 18.1% from a year earlier.

Silver Slides Toward Eight-Month Low as Trump’s Iran Remarks — Silver extended its losses to around $57.7 an ounce on Wednesday, falling to levels not seen since December 2025 after US President Donald Trump declared the interim peace agreement with Iran "over." His comments drove oil prices more than 5% higher, heightening concerns that rising energy costs could fuel inflation and keep US interest rates higher for longer. Speaking at NATO's summit in Ankara, Trump said he had no interest in further engagement with Iran and warned that Washington would likely launch additional strikes later on Wednesday. His remarks marked another abrupt turn in a conflict where rhetoric from both the US and Iran has repeatedly shifted between military escalation and diplomatic efforts. Markets are now pricing in at least one Federal Reserve interest rate hike by the end of 2026, reducing the appeal of non-yielding assets such as silver.

【Fed 9-8-1 dot-plot split exposed; minutes overnight may reveal hawks' case】The Fed will release minutes from its June policy meeting in the early hours of July 9 Beijing time. The June meeting left rates unchanged but the dot plot showed a pronounced 9-8-1 split: nine participants see at least one more hike this year, eight expect unchanged policy and one favors cuts; new chair Kevin Walsh did not submit a dot-plot. June’s statement was markedly shorter with limited forward guidance, so markets see the minutes as the primary window into internal leanings — notably whether the nine hawks are driven by sticky inf and what conditions would prompt renewed tightening. Recent oil-driven rises in energy-input inf have strengthened those concerns. If the minutes show C.BANK remains highly focused on inf risks, expectations that higher rates will be maintained longer could resurface, boosting USD and U.S. Treasury yields, pressuring high-valuation tech and weighing on non-USD assets.

Distillate stockpiles, which include diesel and heating oil, fell by 4.98 million barrels to 103.6 million barrels, compared with forecasts for a 0.6 million-barrel increase. IMF Keeps 2026 Growth Forecast Largely Unchanged — The IMF kept its 2026 global growth forecast virtually unchanged at 3%, just 0.1 percentage point below its April projection, citing the world economy’s stronger-than-expected resilience to the Iran war and robust AI-related investment, according to its July 2026 World Economic Outlook. The 2027 growth outlook was revised upward to 3.4% from 3.2%. Despite the slight upgrades, the IMF warned that risks remain tilted to the downside, and the full economic impact of elevated tensions, including renewed US-Iran strikes, may still take time to materialize. Global headline inflation is now expected to reach 4.7% in 2026, up from 4.1% in 2025, before easing to 3.9% in 2027. The IMF projects growth of 2.3% for the US in 2026 and 2.2% in 2027, while China is expected to expand by 4.6% and 4.1%, respectively. India’s growth is forecast at 6.4% in 2026 and 6.7% in 2027, Japan at 0.6% and 0.7%, the Eurozone at 0.9% and 1.2%, and the UK at 1.0% and 1.3%.

Rice Futures Stay Near 1-Year High — Rice futures traded slightly above $13 per hundredweight, hoding close to their highest since June 2025, amid climate risks and fresh geopolitical tensions. Analysts expect a very strong El Niño to develop in the coming months across key producing regions in Southeast Asia and parts of the Southern Hemisphere, with rice viewed as the most vulnerable crop. Still, global rice stocks remain abundant after successive strong harvests, led by top grower India. World milled rice inventories reached a record 196.2 million tonnes at the start of 2026, with India's stocks climbing to an all-time high of 68.4 million tonnes in June. Indonesia, a major rice importer, is holding record stockpiles as farmers speed up planting to mitigate El Niño risks. In Thailand, inventories are at their highest level in a decade, with fresh second-crop arrivals expected from late July. Meanwhile, renewed Middle East tensions have raised the risk of disruptions to commodity shipments through the Strait of Hormuz.

【Middle East risk spills into grain markets as supply-chain concerns rise】Escalation in the Middle East has pushed oil sharply higher and risk premia are now spilling into agricultural markets. US corn, soy and wheat futures rose intraday as traders repriced higher energy-driven input costs. Oil gains increase fertilizer production and global logistics costs, so sustained oil strength could lift fertilizer, transport and farm production costs and prompt markets to price cost-push inflation. Heightened geopolitical risk around the Black Sea and Middle East — both key grain and energy shipping corridors — raises the probability of supply disruptions; international traders are widening risk premia and reallocating some capital into physical commodities. Market positioning is shifting from a growth-slowdown trade to reassessing a re-flationary mix of energy, food and geo risks.

【US aid model shifts; defense giants face new commercial logic】Trump's push to let Ukraine indigenously produce Patriot air-defense systems and Tomahawk cruise missiles signals a shift in US support from direct fiscal aid to a tech-transfer plus supply-chain-export/outsourcing model. The change forces a re-evaluation of defense contractors' commercial logic: licensing of systems, supply of key components and long-term maintenance contracts can expand overseas revenue and convert one-off government orders into steadier global ecosystem income. It also signals US preparation for a more protracted security commitment, supporting a sustained lift in European defense spending and defense-sector investment. For markets, geopolitical risk is moving from episodic shocks toward structural industry and fiscal shifts; investors may reprice European security assets, the defense sector and energy/resource-linked defensive exposures accordingly.
